subjects.displayTitle: Living waters: thirst, renewal, and a spring within
subjects.introduction: The Euphrates runs clear in full view, ‘Abdu’l-Bahá observes, and the thirsty are nowhere to be found. Living water is first of all a question about thirst: not whether the gift is offered, since Bahá’u’lláh describes a river of life flowing from His Pen to all created things, but whether anyone has the capacity to want it. The thirsty one must run after the water; the fountain will not run after the thirsty. Once tasted, the image multiplies. Water is the manifestation of the All-Merciful upon creation, the meanings hidden in revealed words, the mercy that forgives, the recognition that turns a mirage into a spring, and sometimes, disconcertingly, it is fire or light as well, as if to forbid any merely material reading. Jesus at Jacob’s well promises the Samaritan woman a water that becomes an inward spring, and the Bahá’í writings press that promise toward its consequence: whoever drinks must give others to drink, through a whole lifetime [1]. The way continues toward becoming a source of living waters for others, toward the paired symbols of fire and water, and toward the recognition of God that marks the beginning of new life.
subjects.arc: Begin with thirst and sustained service; explore the image through prayer, revelation, mercy and changing symbols; consider recognition and refusal; follow invitations to drink toward gratitude, transformation and freely sharing with others.

order.why: Give seeking an active direction.
Open with the paradox of visible water and absent thirst.
Ask how the capacity to receive develops.
Imagine spiritual life as a well serving throughout a lifetime.
shortened: The inner, spiritual life of man is like unto this well. He must allay the thirst of the travelers on the path of Truth with the water of significances, not in one or two seasons but during the years of his existence.

order.why: Notice differing capacities at one ocean.
Let the seed express dependence on nurturing rain.
shortened: I am, O my God, but a tiny seed which Thou hast sown in the soil of Thy love, and caused to spring forth by the hand of Thy bounty. This seed craveth, therefore, in its inmost being, for the waters of Thy mercy and the living fountain of Thy grace. Send down upon it, from the heaven of Thy loving-kindness, that which will enable it to flourish beneath Thy shadow and within the borders of Thy court.

order.why: Distinguish bodily water from the water of love.
Introduce the mysteries associated with the name Water of Life.
Open the image to several stated meanings.
Explore the many meanings within the scriptural phrase about water and life.
Read the reported interpretation of Jesus’ saying in its own setting.
Hear the reported citation of the promise to the thirsty.
Let a journey across land and sea lead to the voice associated with Sinai.
shortened: He traversed land and sea until he reached the shore of the Most Great Sea, from whose waves can be heard what Moses heard on the most exalted and ancient Sinai - the spot whereon was established the mighty throne of God.

order.why: Describe arrival at the fountain as spiritual awakening.
Let thirst itself lead the search.
shortened: This thirst will take thee to the spring of the Water of Life, and this search will guide thee to the Sun of Reality.

order.why: Retain the journey from deprivation to the spring.
shortened: O thou who hast believed in God! When, in the desert of deprivation, the intensity of thy thirst increased, thou didst hasten to the fountainhead of the Water of Life and didst drink from the Spring of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Pause over the concise account of thirst answered.
Distinguish a sustaining spring from a mirage.
shortened: So give thanks that God's grace has guided you from the periphery to the center, and from the glass to the lamp. He has freed you from the mirage and guided you to pure honey and the fountain of life.

order.why: Join that distinction with forgiveness and longing for others to know.
shortened: Therefore, strive that you may drink your fill from this life-giving spring, become detached from the mirage of earthly horizons, and through the grace and favor of the Lord become His confidant--that you may drink from the Most Great Ocean and enter beneath the shade of the Ancient Beauty, and say "Would that my people knew how my Lord has forgiven me and made me to be of the honored ones!"

order.why: Turn toward contemplation of the words’ meanings.
shortened: If you seek the spring of living waters, contemplate the meanings in the Words of God.

order.why: Make meaning the offered water.
Join meditation with divine transcendence.
shortened: Meditate on this, that thou mayest drink in the waters of everlasting life which flow through the words of the Lord of all mankind, and mayest testify that the one true God hath ever been immeasurably exalted above His creatures.

order.why: Identify the luminous water with divine words.
Read the Word as education, spirit and heavenly water.
shortened: The Sun of Truth is the Word of God, upon which dependeth the education of those who are endowed with the power of understanding and of utterance. It is the true spirit and the heavenly water, through whose aid and gracious providence all things have been and will be quickened.

order.why: Let living water appear as letters and sunlight.
Invite sustained reading at the book’s fountainhead.
shortened: O thou who art athirst for the Water of Life!  This manifest book is the fountainhead of the Water of Life Eternal.  Drink so much as thou art able from the fountain of the Living Water!

order.why: Retain the direct appeal to drink from the Word.
shortened: Drink thou the pure water of immortality from the word of thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Praised. He who drinketh thereof, neither the allusions of all who dwell on earth can deter him from the Lord of Names, nor the veils of the people of idle fancy from drawing nigh unto the kingdom of his Lord, the Most Glorious.

order.why: Follow the traces of the Pen into gratitude.
Name the Pen’s utterance as a source of life.
shortened: That which floweth from the Most Exalted Pen is the cause of the life of the world - it is the Water of Life.

order.why: Consider the life-giving value assigned to a letter.
Compares revealed words to wells containing the water of life.
Read an instance of interpretation as an offered dewdrop.
shortened: This wronged One will cite but one of these instances, thus conferring upon mankind, for the sake of God, such bounties as are yet concealed within the treasury of the hidden and sacred Tree, that haply mortal men may not remain deprived of their share of the immortal fruit, and attain to a dewdrop of the waters of everlasting life which, from Baghdad, the "Abode of Peace," are being vouchsafed unto all mankind.

order.why: Let the extended sequence of questions connect water, voice, beauty and attraction.
shortened: O Javad! We have desired to cause the waters of everlasting life to flow for thee from this Tablet whereby the life of all in the realm of possibility hath been sustained. Thy Lord is, verily, the Mighty, the Powerful. And We have desired to give thee to drink of the choice wine - dost thou know from which cup, from this manifest cup? And to show thee the Ancient Beauty - dost thou know from which horizon, from this luminous horizon? And to cause thee to hear the Call - dost thou comprehend from which throat, from this most holy and wondrous Throat? And We have desired to attract thee - dost thou know by what thing, by this Word whereby all things have been attracted unto God, the Beloved of the worlds?

order.why: Distinguish the universal offer through words from a temporary restriction on visiting.
Keep the physical Tablet and its delivery within the image.
Join the motive for writing with the motive for reading.
shortened: This Prisoner hath mentioned this Tablet for the sake of God, and you too should read it for the sake of God, that perchance ye may attain unto the Living Waters which flow at the heart of contingent being.

order.why: Let a friend’s letter itself carry enduring love.
shortened: The letter of that soul-friend who, like a spiritual bird soaring in the heaven of inner meanings and singing with various melodies in the branches of remembrance and utterance, stirred this evanescent temple and drew it with the right hand of attraction and rapture, and gave it to drink from the pure water of enduring love which, through divine confirmations, was flowing in the rivers of words.

order.why: Name what is received as inner meanings.
Recall successive cups of knowledge in an addressed relationship.
shortened: We had sent thee before the chalice of divine knowledge, and thou didst drink therefrom through this Name whereby those in all the worlds were subdued. And before that We sent thee a cup which thou didst take and drink from, and We said: "May it be pleasant unto thee, O thou whose heart hath been adorned with the knowledge of God and whose tongue hath been honored by My mention, the Mighty, the Wondrous!"

order.why: Connect reading with strengthened resolve.
shortened: This is a Book from the Wronged One to those who desire to drink the Living Waters from the cups of the bounty of their Lord, the Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, that the Call may attract them to the Supreme Horizon and strengthen them in what they have been commanded in the Preserved Tablet.

order.why: Join revealed counsel to healing the world’s ills.
Retain the account of knowledge descending as water.
Extend the utterance’s life-giving horizon through time.
shortened: Thus have We remembered thee and revealed unto thee that which was and is the Water of Life for all that exist and will exist.

order.why: Keep the call and its warning together.
shortened: The sweet water of life hath flowed from the Pen of the All-Merciful. Blessed is he who hath drunk thereof, and woe unto every heedless and remote one.

order.why: Answer the flowing Pen with praise.
Join water, medicine and light as images of renewal.
Hear the Ocean of Utterance as a continuing gift.
shortened: And verily He is the Ocean of Utterance for all who dwell in the realm of possibility - whoso hath drunk therefrom hath indeed attained unto the Living Waters, and whoso hath turned away is of them who are debarred from this Spirit which at every moment bestoweth the signs of God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Retain the claim of the Primal Point’s reappearance in its source setting.
shortened: O handmaiden of God! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord from this holy and blessed quarter, that there is none other God but Him, and that He Who speaketh at this moment is indeed the Primal Point, Who hath appeared once again - whereat all witnesses and the witnessed were thunderstruck, save those who had quaffed the water of life, and these were but a numbered few.

order.why: Preserve the distinct reference to the waters of the Bayán.
Set an ever-flowing source beside heedlessness.
shortened: At all times the living waters flow and stream forth from the Pen of the All-Merciful, yet heedless souls remain veiled and deprived thereof.

order.why: Join the fountain for the thirsty with the remedy for the sick.
Introduce prayer as living water.
shortened: O thou daughter of the Kingdom!  Know thou that supplication and prayer is the Water of Life.  It is the cause of the vivification of existence, and endows glad-tidings and joy to the souls.

order.why: Read that image within the movements and petitions of the Long Obligatory Prayer.
shortened: Then let him say:

O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Maker of the heavens! I beseech Thee by them Who are the Day-Springs of Thine invisible Essence, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious, to make of my prayer a fire that will burn away the veils which have shut me out from Thy beauty, and a light that will lead me unto the ocean of Thy Presence.
Let him then stand and say:
Make my prayer, O my Lord, a fountain of living waters whereby I may live as long as Thy sovereignty endureth, and may make mention of Thee in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Let forgiveness, revelation, water and fire meet within a prayer.
shortened: I render Thee thanks that Thou hast made known unto Thy servants this Day whereon the river that is life indeed hath flowed forth from the fingers of Thy bounty, and the springtime of Thy revelation and Thy presence hath appeared through Thy manifestation unto all who are in Thy heaven and all who are on Thy earth.

For he would, at one time, discover that from this Pen there floweth out unto all created things the water that is life indeed, and that the Pen itself hath been named by Thee the trumpet whereby the dead speed out of their sepulchers. At another time he would find that there proceedeth from this Pen such fire as Thine own Revelation can kindle, and as He Who conversed with Thee (Moses) on Sinai hath perceived.

order.why: Question a literal reading when the same water appears as fire and light.
Hear one melody through quickening water and attracting fire.
Retain the related account of true life.
shortened: And in certain instances it is known as the Living Waters, for through it the true life of the contingent world is made manifest and realized.

order.why: Preserve the teaching about elements within its theological frame.
shortened: From their elements appeared the elements, such that you see that from their fire appeared the fire in all realms of being, which spoke from the blessed Branch of Unity on the exalted Sinai to Moses the Interlocutor. From their water, every soul finds permanence and life.

order.why: Read the Báb’s water imagery within creation and the Gate.
shortened: God has brought you into being around the Gate and has ordained for you hearts and eyes that you might give thanks to God around the Gate to God, the Truth, the Praiseworthy. Can other than God your Lord bring you in this world the water of camphor, a drink of truth through truth? Exalted is God our Lord, there is no God but Him, and He is the One Who gives His servants to drink from the pure spring in that Gate, and He is the Truth, Who has been witness over all things.

order.why: Let the springtime proclamation connect fragrance, reunion and immortality.
shortened: This is the Day whereon the rushing waters of everlasting life have gushed out of the Will of the All-Merciful.

This is the Day whereon the true servants of God partake of the life-giving waters of reunion, the Day whereon those that are nigh unto Him are able to drink of the soft-flowing river of immortality, and they who believe in His unity, the wine of His Presence, through their recognition of Him Who is the Highest and Last End of all, in Whom the Tongue of Majesty and Glory voiceth the call: "The Kingdom is Mine.

order.why: Retain the paired imagery of mouth and hidden sun.
Keep the addressed account of the honeyed mouth and luminous Kawthar.
shortened: At one time We gave her to drink from My honeyed Mouth, at another caused her to partake of My mighty, My luminous Kawthar.

order.why: Let water itself proclaim the surging ocean.
Name the Day as water, Salsabíl and Kawthar.
shortened: And in another station this Day is the Water of Life for all who dwell in the realm of possibility. It is the true Salsabil and the spiritual Kawthar. From the hand of bounty It bestoweth upon the thirsty that which is the cause of everlasting life. Say: Well is it with them that drink!

order.why: Gather several scriptural names of springs and drinks.
shortened: Drink ye from the hand of the Youth cups of sweet water, then a cup from this Salsabil wherefrom floweth forth the creation of the Kawthar of eternity, then the holy waters and Tasnim.

order.why: Retain the invitation attached to an earlier scriptural saying.
Consider the power attributed to a single drop.
shortened: At one time He appeareth as the water which is Life indeed, sent down out of the heaven of Thy grace, and poured forth from the clouds of thy mercy, that Thy creatures may be endued with new life, and live as long as Thine own Kingdom endureth. Every drop of that water would suffice to quicken the dead, and to set their faces in the direction of Thy favors and Thy gifts, and to rid them of all attachment to aught else except Thee.

order.why: Let that drop hold the taste of many fruits.
shortened: O thou who hast turned unto God! We have desired to give thee to drink of the Water of Life from a chalice whereof if thou shouldst drink but a single drop, thou wouldst find therein the taste of all the fruits and foods of Paradise.

order.why: Extend the image toward unending delight.
Connect the offered cup with rivers of Paradise.
shortened: The fingers of the All-Merciful have proffered the cup of life - whoso drinketh therefrom findeth the delights of the rivers flowing in Paradise.

order.why: Read the chalice’s elusive imagery alongside the call to share.
Quench heedlessness through grace.
Identify living waters with love.
shortened: Praise be to God that thou hast attained to the recognition of the All-Merciful and hast drunk from the Living Waters which are His love.

order.why: Join remembrance with revived hearts.
Let recognition mark the beginning of new life.
shortened: Praise be to God that you have found life through the living waters which are known as the Kawthar of divine knowledge in God's Book, and have attained unto a new life.

order.why: Preserve the Khidr image in the account of guidance.
shortened: O you who are firm in the Covenant! The fountain of the water of life is the very essence of guidance. Praise be to God, you have drunk thereof, and every one who drinks becomes the Khidr of the time.

order.why: Connect wisdom with recognition.
shortened: You have drunk the wine of wisdom from the divine chalice and goblet, and partaken of the living waters from the spring of recognition.

order.why: Join clear recognition to sealed wine.
shortened: Strive that ye may drink of the crystal clear waters of the recognition of His sacred Being and receive your portion of the choice sealed Wine.

order.why: Let certitude yield both water and fruit.
shortened: Drink from the living waters from the spring of certitude, and from this tree of certitude pluck the fruit of the highest heaven.

order.why: Nourish the two leaves through knowledge, assurance and utterance.
shortened: O two blessed leaves! Since you two leaves have grown from the Blessed Tree and have received the drops of the cloud of grace, and have blossomed in this garden of bounty, you must continually increase in freshness and delicacy, and the leaves of Paradise derive their vitality from the water of life - and that is the cup of mystical knowledge, the wine of certitude, assurance, explanation and utterance.

order.why: Keep growth at the spring as an ongoing process.
shortened: It is fitting that in this supreme paradise, like the merciful leaves, you should be nourished by the living waters and grow and develop from the Spring of Tasnim.

order.why: Read the promise of flourishing trees in the vineyard.
shortened: Soon will your Lord make you growing trees in His wonderful vineyard, blossoming, leafing and bearing fruits of the paradise of El-ABHA through the shadow of His Name, the Merciful, the Clement.

order.why: Recognize renewal through a small morning dew.
Set knowledge beside the limitless ocean of favor.
Let certitude’s fountain overflow in the garden.
shortened: The gardens of Paradise have drawn near, and the sacred precincts of the All-Merciful have been adorned, and the fountains of divine knowledge are overflowing, and the Kawthar of certitude hath gushed forth with sweet, pleasant, delightful water - a drink blessed for those who partake of it.

order.why: Picture the ocean’s waves reaching existence.
shortened: The lights of the Abha Kingdom have encompassed the heavenly realms, and the waves of the Most Great Ocean have poured forth upon the arena of existence.

order.why: Explore the reported movement from scattered drops to a torrent.
shortened: Your faith comes like rain; the first drops are far between, but soon it will pour in torrents.
The Spirit resembles a rivulet when the earth fills the soul. Put away the terrestrial and the mighty torrent of living water will rush through your freed body.

order.why: Hold water, fire and Spirit together in baptismal imagery.
shortened: He has baptized you with the water of Life, the Fire of the Love of God and the Spirit of His Knowledge and ushered you into His Kingdom and bestowed upon you His Kingdom and bestowed upon you Eternal Life!

order.why: Retain the reported prayer for awakened sight and hearing.
Ask what leaves an enduring trace in the address to a woman.
shortened: O maid-servant of God! Many a spiritual woman came (into the world) and passed away in vain; no sound is heard of them and no trace of them is seen; inasmuch as their spirits were not dependent upon the Holy Spirit, nor were they attracted to the fragrances of Truth; nor were they ever baptized by the Water of Life, nor by the Spirit of Truth which speaketh in the assemblies of the Kingdom and which breathes upon spirits the breezes which waft an eternal glory, the signs of which are everlasting.

order.why: Keep the reported account of structures sustained through revelation.
Preserve the third-hand account’s claims and interpretive parenthesis.
shortened: When it was remarked that this would disappoint a great many people [we quote the letter received by us], "he replied that he had talked on every subject, from the scientific as well as psychological basis and that he breathed on the souls and spirits of all the Bahais in such a way that had it been upon bone, it would have taken on flesh (meaning, as I understood it, that he had given really life-giving spirit) and that if their souls were not on fire now, verily they were dead—just as a tree which is not green and does not show forth any signs of life though the most nourishing life-giving rains are pouring down upon it, and the fresh spring breezes flowing down upon it.

order.why: Hear the call to awaken through the offered water.
Read the contrast between receiving life and refusing the fountain.
Retain the text’s spiritual use of life and death.
Join wholehearted striving to that demanding distinction.
Keep sincerity and veiling within the source’s claim.
Set refusal beside the wine of reunion.
shortened: They who have deprived themselves of the Living Waters in the days of the All-Merciful are indeed the lost, while they who have turned unto the Truth and quaffed the choice wine of reunion are the triumphant ones.

order.why: Preserve the unsettling contrast of poison and life in its theological setting.
shortened: He hath appeared in the garment of "I am" and speaketh forth with "I am the One Who is manifest." This is the deadly poison for the evil ones and the water of life for the righteous.

order.why: Question turning from life toward polluted waters.
shortened: The sovereign of minds is bewildered at those who have cast behind their backs the Water of Life and hastened unto the foulest of waters.

order.why: Retain the sharp image of the infernal tree.
Hear the lament at widespread deprivation.
shortened: The Supreme Pen at all times summons humanity to the Most Glorious Horizon, yet all are observed to be as dead save a few who have drunk from the Living Waters and, in the path of the All-Merciful, have detached themselves from all who dwell on earth.

order.why: Distinguish reception from religious and political rank.
shortened: How many were the divines and princes who remained deprived of the Water of Life, while thou, praise be to God, didst attain unto it and drink therefrom.

order.why: Keep the warning against following others without discernment.
shortened: Beware lest the allusions of those who have disbelieved in God veil thee, or the veils of those who hesitate prevent thee - they who have been debarred from the Living Waters because they followed every ignorant remote one.

order.why: Consider the veils of humanity before the pure fountain.
shortened: Turn ye unto the Most Pure Fountain! Beware lest the veils of humanity prevent you from this mighty prospect.

order.why: Leave the stagnant pool for living water.
shortened: How wonderful, how wonderful that thou hast lifted thy gaze from the stagnant pool and attained unto the living waters of Kawthar!

order.why: Retain differing responses to one widely offered gift.
Keep the blessing and warning together.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath quaffed from the living waters of utterance proffered by the hand of the bounty of his Lord, the All-Merciful, and woe betide those who have turned away.

order.why: Hear the loss conveyed by withheld water and closed reunion.
Locate the offer in revelation appearing in a human temple.
Return to the invitation addressed to all creation.
shortened: O My Most Exalted Pen! Say: O concourse of creation, come ye, come ye, that I may give you to drink of the Water of Life.

order.why: Hear the call to the people of the earth.
Retain the appeal to drink and resist denial.
Bring the surging gift close to the hearer.
Keep the continuing offer of water.
shortened: We give to drink the water of life at all times - blessed is he who attains unto it in these days of God, the Sovereign, the Mighty, the Powerful, the Beloved.

order.why: Retain the invitation to those who have turned.
Drink through the repeated remembrance of divine names.
Preserve the compact invitation in the Name.
Take the cup within the days of the All-Merciful.
shortened: O servant! Take thou the cup of life in the days of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, then drink therefrom in His Name, the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

order.why: Let the call interrupt heedlessness.
Keep attention fixed on the life-giving waters.
Retain resolve amid denial.
shortened: Drink ye of the Water of Life, despite those who have denied this irrevocable Cause.

order.why: Preserve the parallel counsel in its addressed setting.
shortened: Take, in the Most Great Name, the Kawthar of eternity, then drink thereof despite every denier who hath denied the Cause of God, the Glorious, the Praised.

order.why: Keep the powerful image of overcoming the greatest idol.
shortened: Drink thou the Kawthar of life at all times through this Name whereby the back of the greatest idol was broken and the hearts of those who disbelieved in God, the Lord of all worlds, were consumed.

order.why: Receive the waters unsealed through grace.
Turn yearning toward the pure spring and the Sun of Truth.
Give hope the action of walking toward its goal.
Bless the work of seeking.
shortened: Blessed then are those who seek, and joy be to those who strive toward this spring of living waters.

order.why: Remember the person who desires to drink.
shortened: A mention from Us to him who desires to drink the living waters from the hands of his Lord's bounty, the All-Merciful, and to be numbered among those who have attained.

order.why: Make the invitation personal through greetings to two women.
Read a letter’s steadfastness as a cause of joy.
shortened: O thou who art thirsty for the water of life of the Kingdom! Your letter was received and brought joy to my heart, for it was evidence of firmness and steadfastness.

order.why: Retain gratitude for reaching the fountain.
shortened: O thou who art guided by the lights of God's guidance! Praise be to God that thou hast arrived at the spring of eternal life and drunk from the pure fountain of living waters.

order.why: Join drinking with hearing an unseen call.
shortened: Praise be to God that a spring of the water of life gushed forth and thou didst drink therefrom, and the angel of the unseen raised a cry and thou didst hear its call.

order.why: Ask for continuing knowledge and orientation.
shortened: God willing, may they all at all times drink from the everlasting fountain of divine knowledge and remain oriented toward the horizon of His Cause.

order.why: Bring yearning, remembrance and steadfast love together.
Join the day of recognition to service.
shortened: God saith: O My handmaidens! This is the Day of mention and utterance, and this is the Day of service and recognition. Strive ye that ye may quaff from the living waters and behold yourselves abiding and enduring beneath the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree in the kingdom of earth and heaven.

order.why: Keep joy and remembrance in the address to the Greatest Leaf.
shortened: O Greatest Leaf! The Supreme Pen commands: In all conditions be occupied with the remembrance of the Friend and with the utmost joy and fragrance drink from the life-giving water.

order.why: Make drinking and remembrance continuous.
Preserve the related invitation to enduring remembrance.
shortened: God willing, at all times drink ye of this manifest nectar which is the cause and reason for the quickening of the worlds, and be ye occupied with the remembrance of the true Object of all desire.

order.why: Remember strangers seeking shelter and thirsty souls seeking water.
Begin the prayers with thirst and spiritual poverty.
shortened: He who was athirst, O my Lord, hath hasted to attain the living waters of Thy grace, and the wretched creature hath yearned to immerse himself beneath the ocean of Thy riches.

order.why: Ask where else the thirsty soul could turn.
Let a short petition speak plainly.
shortened: Thirsty are we: give us the Water of Life!

order.why: Retain the reported prayer for access to bounty.
Move through fish, bird and ocean in seeking forgiveness.
shortened: Cause this thirsty one to reach the Fountain of Life, and let this fish to plunge into the Infinite Ocean of forgiveness--so that this bird may soar unto the rose-garden of the Merciful One and enter into the meadows of boundless forgiveness and pardon.

order.why: Join pardon to the quenching of thirst.
Ask for participation in mercy and grace.
shortened: Grant, then, O my God, that Thy servant who hath turned towards Thee, hath fixed his gaze upon Thee, and clung to the cord of Thy mercifulness and favor, may be enabled to partake of the living waters of Thy mercy and grace.

order.why: Let the fingers of mercy offer loving-kindness.
shortened: Help us then to quaff, O my God, from the fingers of mercy the living waters of Thy loving-kindness, that we may utterly forget all else except Thee, and be occupied only with Thy Self.

order.why: Pray for detachment through mercy’s beverage.
Keep wine and living waters together in a prayer for grace.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of eternity and Educator of the world, to give me to drink of the choice wine of grace from the hands of Thy bounty and the living waters of loving-kindness from the fingers of Thy favor.

order.why: Ask release from vain imaginings.
shortened: Thou seest how I have turned myself toward Thee, and set my face in the direction of Thy grace and Thy gifts. I implore Thee, by Thy name through which Thou didst enable all them that have recognized Thy unity to partake of the wine of Thy mercy, and all such as have drawn nigh unto Thee to quaff the living waters of Thy loving-kindness, to rid me entirely of all vain imaginings, and to incline me in the direction of Thy grace, O Thou Who art the Lord of all men!

order.why: Pray for attraction to the verses and steadfast orientation.
shortened: Say: O God of Names and Creator of Heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Compelling over all things, through which the gate of Thy bounty was opened to all who are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, and the Water of Life flowed forth amongst Thy creatures, to make me attracted to Thy verses, detached from all else but Thee, and in all conditions turned toward the horizon from which shone forth the Sun of Thy Manifestation.

order.why: Seek renewed life in every condition.
shortened: I implore Thee, by this very word that hath shone forth above the horizon of Thy will, to enable me to drink deep of the living waters through which Thou hast vivified the hearts of Thy chosen ones and quickened the souls of them that love Thee, that I may, at all times and under all conditions, turn my face wholly towards Thee.

order.why: Let water strengthen sight, heart, soul and steps.
Ask that others’ eyes open to recognition.
shortened: I entreat Thee, therefore, O my God, by Thy Name through which Thou hast guided Thy lovers to the living waters of Thy grace and Thy favors, and attracted them that long for Thee to the Paradise of Thy nearness and Thy presence, to open the eyes of Thy people that they may recognize in this Revelation the manifestation of Thy transcendent unity, and the dawning of the lights of Thy countenance and Thy beauty.

order.why: Pray that those already guided are not turned away.
shortened: Since Thou hast guided them, O my Lord, unto the living waters of Thy grace, grant, by Thy bounty, that they may not be kept back from Thee; and since Thou hast summoned them to the habitation of Thy throne, drive them not out from Thy presence, through Thy loving-kindness.

order.why: Retain the petition that no servant be deprived.
Join flowing water with the lamp and fragrant breath.
shortened: Roll not up, O my Lord, what hath been spread out in Thy name, and extinguish not the lamp which Thine own fire hath lit. Withhold not, O my Lord, the water that is life indeed from running down --the water from whose murmuring the wondrous melodies which extol and glorify Thee can be heard. Deny not, moreover, Thy servants the sweet fragrance of the breath which hath been wafted through Thy love.

order.why: Keep the related plea for continued flow.
Ask for water every day and moment.
shortened: Give us, then, to drink from the hands of Thy grace every day and every moment of our lives of the waters that are life indeed, O Thou Who art the Most Merciful!

order.why: Retain the prayer’s appeal to eternity.
Join the heart’s fire with the flowing Kawthar.
shortened: Then kindle her heart at all times with the fire of Thy love, and give her to drink from the Kawthar of life which floweth from the right hand of the throne of Thy majesty.

order.why: Pray through the images of sun, ocean and heaven.
shortened: Say: O God, O Master of existence and Educator of the seen and unseen! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the sun of Thy power hath shone forth and the ocean of Thy Will and favors hath surged and the heaven of Thy grandeur and bounty hath been upraised, to give me to drink, at all times, the water of life from Thy white hand and Thy most glorious finger.

order.why: Ask for the life of attaining the divine presence.
Follow the servant into fields and wilderness of mercy.
shortened: O my God! This is Thy servant who hastened to the fields of Thy mercy and ran to the wilderness wherein no voice is heard except Thy voice, and who sought to drink from the clouds of Thy grace and bounty.

order.why: Answer the Pen’s attraction with a plea for the river.
shortened: When the rustling of My Most Exalted Pen attracteth thee, say: O Lord of Names! I beseech Thee by Thy grace to withhold me not from the river of Thy mercy and the ocean of Thy bounty.

order.why: Join healing, assurance and firm steps.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee for Thou hast guided every thirsty one to the Fountain of Life and every ailing one to the Merciful Physician. Illumine the heart of this Thy servant with the light of Assurance, make firm his feet in the straight Path and Manifest Road, and suffer him to drink from the Clear Spring and the Water of Tasneem.

order.why: Extend the prayer to servants in every direction.
Pray for believers’ immersion.
Let renewed hearts open into a living garden of many creatures.
shortened: O Lord! Expand the breasts of the sincere ones through witnessing the manifest light, heal the hearts of the believers with the cup of Thy grace overflowing with the living waters, open before their faces the gates of ease, shine upon them the lights of joy, shower upon them the rains of bounty, and assist them with the lions of guidance, until the birds of holiness warble in those verdant gardens, and the lions of truth roar in those mighty thickets, and the whales of mystical knowledge swim in those vast pools.

order.why: Recall those who received with submission and assurance.
Keep reunion within a wider scene of joy and accountability.
Retain the brief blessing on those who have attained.
shortened: Blessed art thou and blessed are they who have attained unto the Water of Life in the days of their Lord, the All-Merciful.

order.why: Bless steadfastness amid opposing voices.
Answer receiving with praise.
Connect the waters with reunion.
shortened: Blessed are they who in this blessed Day have drunk from the hands of bounty the living waters of immortality and have joined with the Beloved of all worlds.

order.why: Give thanks for not remaining deprived.
Join fragrance, turning and drinking.
shortened: Blessed is the soul that hath found the fragrance of His raiment and turned toward His horizon and quaffed the living waters from the cup of His bounty.

order.why: Retain gratitude for grace and orientation.
shortened: Praise be to God that through the grace of the All-Merciful thou hast drunk from the living waters and turned toward the supreme horizon.

order.why: Set mercy’s river amid surrounding darkness.
shortened: Praise be to God that in such days, when darkness hath encompassed the world, thou hast attained unto the living waters and drunk from the river of mercy.

order.why: Hear the repeated blessing upon those who drink.
shortened: I swear by the sun of the heaven of proof - whosoever attaineth unto it and drinketh thereof, the Tongue of Grandeur shall utter the blessed words "Well is it with those who drink!" and "Happy are they who drink!"

order.why: Connect receiving with the lifting of veils.
Find shelter as well as water in the utterance.
Retain the testimony of loving-kindness and presence.
shortened: I testify that thou didst drink the living waters from the hand of thy Lord's loving-kindness, the All-Merciful, and didst attain His presence in the highest paradise.

order.why: Keep recognition and detachment within its addressed counsel.
shortened: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the recognition of God, thy Lord, and having drunk the water of life from the fingers of thy Lord's will, the Most Merciful, and having detached thyself from every rejected misbeliever.

order.why: Let renewed people adorn the kingdom.
Preserve the promise of everlasting life.
Keep the concise blessing upon a recipient.
Receive mystical knowledge in the name of the Beloved.
shortened: Praise be to God that, through God's infinite loving-kindness, thou hast quaffed from the cup of mystic knowledge the living waters in the name of the Beloved of all creation.

order.why: Retain the thanksgiving for the Lord’s praise.
Give thanks for utterance, hearing, strength and arrival.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of the world and Educator of the nations, for having given me to drink from the Kawthar of Thy utterance and caused me to hear Thy call and strengthened me through the means of the heavens and earth, until Thou didst cause me to be present before Thy face and to stand at the gate of Thy grandeur and might.

order.why: Give recognition a spoken response of gratitude.
Answer the discovered spring with praise.
Preserve the image of a formerly sealed gift.
shortened: This is one of Thy servants who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy grace and desired the wonders of Thy bounty and favor. He hath attained unto the living waters which were sealed with the seal of Thy might and power.

order.why: Join blessed days to the life-giving Pen.
Keep the claim that divine will quickens through this water.
shortened: By My life! It is indeed the water of life for all who are in the heavens and on earth. Through it God quickeneth whomsoever He willeth of His creation.

order.why: Let the watering of a raised creation extend the image.
Hear the collective invitation of the surging ocean.
shortened: The ocean of attainment hath surged and the Dayspring of Beauty calleth: Drink ye, O concourse of loved ones!

order.why: Ask whether receiving life can leave a person silent.
shortened: Hath anyone drunk from the living waters and remained silent, or failed to attain thereunto and remained heedless? By God's life! Whoso drinketh thereof will be seized with such longing that he will arise and exclaim: "By God! The Beloved hath come with His mighty and impregnable dominion!"

order.why: Join taking the Tablet with giving others to drink.
Make receiving the beginning of offering.
shortened: Drink thou from the water of life, then give to drink them that dwell in the realm of possibility, that it may draw them nigh unto the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

order.why: Keep that exchange continuous.
Offer freely to all humanity.
Let knowledge be given without payment.
Make guidance of the thirsty an urgent task.
shortened: Therefore must the friends of God strive mightily, night and day, that perchance they may guide those who have gone astray unto the straight path, and give the thirsty to drink of this living water.

order.why: Join remembrance with giving water to others.
Retain the overflowing ocean and its drops in shared service.
Offer in the divine name throughout life.
shortened: He calleth upon Thee at all times, and offereth in Thy name the Water of Life to the people of Thy kingdom.

order.why: Pray that friends can guide the thirsty and lost.
Share the gift with those deprived.
shortened: Arise to serve Him so that you may become the cause of guidance for a great multitude, give the thirsty to drink from the Salsabil (heavenly spring), and grant a share and portion from the greatest gift to those who are deprived.

order.why: Keep guidance and renewed life together.
shortened: Honored Aqa Siyyid Jalal, having arrived from those regions, brings glad tidings of the power of faith and intensity of certitude of the friends - that those holy souls are alive with the divine breath and fresh and verdant from the breeze of providence. They have a passion in their heads and hearts aflame in their breasts. They touch the heart and soul of every unaware one and make those who are lost and bewildered become enamored with the face of the Beloved. They give the Water of Guidance to the thirsty and bestow the Water of Life to the dead.

order.why: Pair water with the bread of life in the reported utterance.
shortened: I satisfy the hungry ones with the Bread of life and allay the thirst of the thirsty ones with the pure Water of Immortality.

order.why: Imagine receiving becoming refreshment for many kinds of need.
Let a person become a spring approached by others.
Water the saplings through the channels of hearts.
Join giving water with the fire of devoted life.
shortened: Quench the thirst of those who are parched in the desert of longing with the living waters in this exalted Paradise, and cause the moths of love and affection to circle round the brilliant lamp and burn their wings in the heat of its luminous flame, that they may become the manifestation of 'We shall surely give them a good life' and the dawning-place of 'Nay, they are alive and are provided sustenance from their Lord.'

order.why: Honor the sacrifice of comfort for seekers.
Give the hoped-for spring a particular locality.
shortened: The intention is that the spring of life may flow there and the fountain of life may gush forth in Sari.

order.why: Notice withered plants and the need to return to mercy.
shortened: He said the plants of God's garden have withered from lack of water - someone must return to the Euphrates of the All-Merciful's mercy so that all may be refreshed by the sweet fragrances of the mention of their Chosen Lord.

order.why: Consider sweetness growing through continued flow.
Keep the addressed hope of reviving friends.
shortened: Like the water of life, he will cause the hearts of the friends to be revived, and will tear asunder the leaves of doubts about God's Covenant that have spread throughout the horizons, becoming the manifestation of the favors of the Luminary of the horizons.

order.why: Let greetings themselves carry renewed life.
Join gratitude for finding the spring with raising the call.
Name the quickening of others as a supreme deed.
Consider how a single deed may give life to many.
Read teaching as the cultivation of sources of light.
shortened: Teachings were revealed and counsels and admonitions were issued so that souls might become centers of divine inspirations and sources of heavenly lights, that each might become a horizon of truth and a mirror of the grace of the Abha Kingdom, that the light might shine forth and the fragrance of flowers and the morning breeze might waft and perfume the nostrils of the spiritually-minded.

order.why: Retain the demanding contrast between awakening and heedlessness.
shortened: All humanity is caught in the slumber of heedlessness while you are awake; all are dead while you have attained eternal life and are raising the call to the divine Kingdom and are the cause of illumination of the human world.

order.why: End the generosity movement at its own ocean.
Receive a portion from ocean and cornfield alike.
Retain the connection between duty and living waters.
shortened: You must certainly guide everyone to perform their prayers, for it is the ascension of spirits and the lamp of the hearts of the righteous. It is the living waters of the paradise of good-pleasure and an explicitly ordained duty from the All-Merciful.

order.why: Let spiritual nourishment call for continued participation.
Give renewed life an exuberant melody of gratitude.
Learn seeking and devotion through birds and candle.
Welcome the spiritual morning without remaining deprived.
Pray that all may partake of the life-giving ocean.
shortened: We beseech God to assist His people and guide them to the Most Great Ocean that all may partake of that which bestoweth life and granteth everlasting existence.

order.why: Join purification with recognition of the long-invoked Beauty.
Name the flowing river of sanctification.
shortened: Today the river of sanctification floweth and the ocean of purification surgeth.

order.why: Close the linked readings with grace without measure.
shortened: Purify thyself with the living waters flowing from the right hand of the Throne, then seek His grace, for His grace descendeth upon all created things without measure or count.

order.why: Preserve the supplied prayer fragment and its unresolved omission.
Retain Izutsu’s account of Ibn ‘Arabi as a distinct philosophical voice.

questions: What might spiritual thirst mean, and how do the passages distinguish readiness to receive from merely being near a source?
Which meanings of living water emerge through love, mercy, recognition, prayer, and revealed words, and how do those meanings enrich one another?
What changes when water also appears as fire, light, wine, or a voice, and how might these shifting images guide a reading of symbolic language?
How do the contrasts between life and death, spring and mirage, or clear and stagnant water invite examination of one’s own response?
How does Jesus’ conversation with the Samaritan woman illuminate the relation between receiving living water and becoming a spring, while retaining its particular account of revelation and worship?
What would it mean to offer freely what has renewed one’s life, and how could a person or community become a dependable source of refreshment over time?

references.label: 1 · John 4:4–26 · The Samaritan woman and living water
references.note: Read the whole conversation at Jacob’s well: an ordinary request for water crosses a social boundary and opens questions of gift, recognition, inward life, and worship. Compare these movements with the compilation’s calls to thirst, drink, and share, while keeping the Gospel’s account of Jesus and the woman’s unfolding recognition in view.

subjects.displayTitle: Spiritual wine: the exhilaration that awakens
subjects.introduction: Ordinary wine dulls the senses and ends in a headache; the wine Bahá’u’lláh pours increases consciousness, sharpens discernment and leaves the drinker more awake than before. That reversal is the key to a whole vocabulary of cups, cupbearers, taverns and feasts, where intoxication names the exhilaration of recognising the Beloved and loving Him past the point of calculation. The symbol will not sit still: the cup can be a Tablet received by post, the Covenant, fairness, knowledge, even a banquet of trials whose varied flavours ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describes with startling relish. The Qur’án’s promise of sealed wine and the spring of Tasním gives the imagery its scriptural root [1], and Paul’s appeal to be filled with the Spirit rather than with wine points to the same waking fullness that spills into song and service [2]. The exhilaration is never meant to be kept; whoever drinks is asked to pour for others and to sprinkle a drop on the earth. From here the journey leads into the mystical themes of the Writings, the wider language of symbolism, and the slow work of spiritual transformation that such joy sets in motion.
subjects.arc: Begin with the paradox of an intoxication that increases awareness; explore the cup’s changing meanings, revelation and covenant; follow joy through longing and trial into gratitude, shared utterance and service.

order.why: Open with wine that increases consciousness.
Make discernment and wakefulness its stated effects.
Contrast lasting awareness with momentary exhilaration.
shortened: O thou who art intoxicated with the wine of the love of God! The wine of the vineyard and the pleasant beverage yield but a momentary exhilaration, and its turbulent sea is but a dewdrop. The divine wine, however, imparteth eternal joy and delight, and its brimming, triumph-laden chalice is overflowing. Should anyone partake of a drop of this divine wine, he will be roused from unconsciousness to consciousness, and will be delivered from the stupor of heedlessness and the intoxication of ignorance and error. Therefore, one must seek this everlasting nectar and not the bitter, perishable water.

order.why: Distinguish the wine of pride as well as material wine.
shortened: O thou who art intoxicated with the wine of divine love! Some people are drunk and joyous from the wine of grapes, yet in the morning they are hung over and sluggish. Some are intoxicated with the wine of pride, but in the end they are harmed and deprived. Others are in ecstasy from the pure wine of the love of God and in joy from the wine of the knowledge of God.

order.why: Keep reason and understanding within spiritual joy.
Join exhilaration to continuing search.
Test different kinds of apparent ecstasy by their effects.
shortened: But their aims and conditions are different and diverse - one is inebriated from the overflowing divine cup, while another is drunk and proud from the wine of vanity. Some are dancing and rejoicing from the eternal wine of recognition, while others are unconscious and suffering from the deadly poison of heedlessness and error.

order.why: Ask what makes love endure and grow.
shortened: You must become intoxicated with the wine of spiritual love. When one is intoxicated with the material wine, it sometimes increases the love in the heart, but this love does not last; the next day it is entirely gone. But the intense love created from the wine of the Holy Spirit intoxicates the heart and the effect is eternal, growing stronger each day.

order.why: Retain the reported contrast of lasting joy and pain.
shortened: The cup of the material world is followed by pain, but the Divine cup, the cup of the Love of God, has an everlasting intoxication, and pain follows it not. Happy are those who are intoxicated with this intoxication!

order.why: Keep the historical comparison in its reported setting.
Question mere tipsiness through the wine of faithfulness.
Give thanks for joy without material drinking.
shortened: At every breath offer a thousand thanks that without drinking at night or the sound of harp and music, you have found the intoxication of the wine of guidance and attained the utmost joy and delight.

order.why: Read the mystical cup within the prayer for freedom from intoxicants.
Open the symbol to its expressly stated multiple interpretations.
Distinguish wine from its changing cup.
Let the poem complicate even that distinction.
Read a received cup as an explicitly interpreted symbol.
shortened: O happy starred Prince and noble King!

The Gift you have forwarded was very acceptable, because it was from your Highness that it came; especially this exiled one over mountain and plain and this wanderer over land and sea took that cup as a symbol, signifying:- "I am thirsty for the Water of Reality and longing for intoxication with the Wine of Knowledge."

order.why: Explore the text’s interpretation of Qur’anic drinks.
shortened: Say: By God! The wine mentioned in the Qur'an is My love, and the Kawthar is My remembrance, and the milk is that which is concealed within My words, and the honey is My sweetest utterance, the mighty, the inaccessible. Say: O people of vain desires! That wine increaseth heedlessness, while this wine bestoweth life everlasting.

order.why: Retain the related explanation through Kawthar, Salsabíl and Tasním.
Name divine bounty, revelation and new spirit within the wine.
shortened: For that divine wine is the ancient bounty and the wondrous revelation and the new spirit of the Ever-Living, All-Powerful Lord that is manifest in this mighty Cycle. For that goblet has come round, and that flagon is in the hand of the Cup-bearer, and that chalice is brimming, and that tavern has reopened, and that wine-vault has begun to flow, and those wine-lovers have begun to cry out.

order.why: Let the cup convey glad tidings and merciful breaths.
shortened: That cup is divine glad-tidings and that wine the breaths of the All-Merciful. Sacrifice a hundred thousand cups for a single drop of that wine and become ready for the altar of love.

order.why: Pair knowledge with wisdom in a reported counsel.
Connect wisdom with the spring of recognition.
shortened: You have drunk the wine of wisdom from the divine chalice and goblet, and partaken of the living waters from the spring of recognition.

order.why: Enter knowledge, wisdom and utterance through the cup.
shortened: Take thou a cup of My choice-sealed wine, then drink thereof in My Name, the Self-Subsisting. Verily it will draw thee nigh unto thy Lord and cause thee to enter the pavilion of knowledge, wisdom and utterance.

order.why: Let insight and the limits of names enter the feast.
Compare the legendary cup of Jamshíd with enduring inner meanings.
shortened: O thou servant of the Abha Beauty!

They say that Jamshid possessed a world-reflecting cup, and some maintain it was a goblet adorned with precious jewels. When one drank from that cup, like a whale in the ocean would one surge and cry out from the joy of its wine. Although that cup brought joy and gladness and was the cause of delight and bliss, yet its exhilaration lasted but a moment and its ocean was but a dewdrop. This divine cup, however, is filled to overflowing with the wine of inner meanings, and its exhilaration endureth forever.

order.why: Keep the Síyávash comparison within its poetic address.
Preserve the Bahram and Ahriman imagery and its address to Núsh.
Read the call to Jamshíd within this poetic world.
Let the cup of Jamshíd become an invitation to the Covenant’s feast.
Take a cup that appears as the Word and pass it among others.
Receive the heavenly message as a passed cup of mercy.
Let loving intention shape the wine of utterance.
Find a feast in a letter’s meanings and contents.
Receive the letter itself as a cup of recognition.
shortened: O two shining lamps! Your letter brought joy through Muhammad-Nabi the butcher, Tirandaz Khusraw, and Ardishir Khusraw, for it was a cup brimming with the wine of recognition of the Lord.

order.why: Ask whether a brief letter can carry lasting joy.
shortened: His honor Khan is not content with this brief letter and says "How can these wines suffice for our intoxication?" I say, O calculating man, this is the wine from the wine-cellar of the Covenant and its cup-bearer is the fingers of 'Abdu'l-Baha - one drop brings eternal intoxication and everlasting joy.

order.why: Let the spoken call overflow in a loving heart.
shortened: O thou who art attracted unto the Beauty of ABHA! Verily I call thee, from this Spot, with a speech whereby the spirit is breathed into hearts and bodies, and address thee with a calling whereby His clear wine overflows in the fountain of a heart which is consumed by the love of God.

order.why: Read the addressed response to the wine of utterance.
Let receiving utterance become speaking in remembrance.
shortened: This is a Book from the presence of One mighty and generous unto him who hath believed in God, the Single, the All-Informed, that the wine of utterance may so intoxicate him that he will speak in remembrance of his Lord, the All-Merciful, detached from all who dwell on earth.

order.why: Turn toward God when the verses’ rapture comes.
shortened: When the rapture of My verses overtaketh thee and the wine of My remembrance and utterance intoxicateth thee, turn thy face toward God, the Help in Peril, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Return the recipient to reading the Tablet.
Drink from the utterance’s Kawthar.
shortened: Drink thou the choice wine of life from the Kawthar of thy Lord's utterance, the All-Merciful.

order.why: Retain the direct offering of words as wine.
shortened: Thus have We given thee the choice wine of utterance - drink thou in the name of thy Lord, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling.

order.why: Bless the recipient of utterance.
shortened: Blessed is he in that he drank the choice wine of utterance from the hand of the bounty of his Lord, the Most Merciful.

order.why: Answer the Pen’s gift with gratitude amid imprisonment.
shortened: O thou who hast turned towards Me, when thou hast drunk the choice wine which hath flowed from the Pen of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, say: "Praise be unto Thee, O Creator of the worlds, for having remembered me in the prison when I was in the hands of the wicked ones!"

order.why: Give the recipient words of thanksgiving.
shortened: When thou hast quaffed the choice wine of utterance from the cup of the bounty of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, then render thanks and say: "Thine is the bounty, O Possessor of Names, and Thine is the grace, O Thou through Whom every mighty cause hath appeared!"

order.why: Connect revelation’s fragrance with praise of the All-Loving.
Hear the announcement of the broken seal.
shortened: The seal of the choice Wine of His Revelation hath, in this Day and in His Name, the Self-Sufficing, been broken. Its grace is being poured out upon men. Fill thy cup, and drink in, in His Name, the Most Holy, the All-Praised.

order.why: Let the unsealing diffuse the Beloved’s fragrance.
Hold the universal offer beside differing responses.
Receive the offered cup with longing.
shortened: The hands of bounty have borne round the cup of everlasting life. Approach, and quaff your fill. Drink with healthy relish, O ye that are the very incarnations of longing, ye who are the embodiments of vehement desire!"

order.why: Give the invitation its urgency.
shortened: In His right hand is a chalice of the Kawthar of immortality and He saith: Come and drink, O people of Baha, and be not of the patient ones.

order.why: Join drinking with public remembrance.
Keep the gift of remembrance both open and hidden.
shortened: We give the world to drink of the wine of remembrance, both secretly and openly. Blessed is he who has turned and attained unto this sealed nectar.

order.why: Let receiving wine accompany participation in knowledge.
shortened: God willing, thou shalt partake of the sealed wine and receive thy portion from the ocean of knowledge.

order.why: Set aside other cups for the offered one.
Retain the brief invitation through remembrance.
shortened: Take thou the chalice in My Name, then drink therefrom through My wondrous remembrance.

order.why: Let successive divine names deepen the act of drinking.
Take loving-kindness from the hand of bounty.
Let seeking lead toward the true Friend.
shortened: Strive that perchance thou mayest drink of the everlasting Kawthar from the hand of the spiritual Cup-bearer and attain unto the true Friend.

order.why: Read fairness and love within the account of divine commandments.
shortened: The Tongue of My power hath, from the heaven of My omnipotent glory, addressed to My creation these words: "Observe My commandments, for the love of My beauty." Happy is the lover that hath inhaled the divine fragrance of his Best-Beloved from these words, laden with the perfume of a grace which no tongue can describe. By My life! He who hath drunk the choice wine of fairness from the hands of My bountiful favour will circle around My commandments that shine above the Dayspring of My creation.

order.why: Join ordinances to the soul’s life and nearness.
Enter inner meanings through contentment and attachment to the Beloved.
shortened: 64 O friend, till thou enter the garden of these inner meanings, thou shalt never taste of the imperishable wine of this valley. And shouldst thou taste of it, thou wilt turn away from all else and drink of the cup of contentment; thou wilt loose thyself from all things and bind thyself unto Him, and lay down thy life in His path and offer up thy soul for His sake.

order.why: Follow submission and contentment toward reunion.
Read relief from vanity through knowledge and submission.
shortened: Drink the wine of divine love with the countenance of the holy, eternal Beauty's manifestation. Make your dwelling in the shallow waters of the stream of glorious Paradise and the flowing of the holy Salsabil of submission, so that, intoxicated and bewildered by the exhilaration and rapture of the wine from the vessels of divine knowledge, you may find relief from the vanities of this transient earth and the defilements of this dusty realm.

order.why: Let true knowledge overcome veils and opposing might.
Distinguish spiritual freedom from idle fancies.
Leave the wine of delusion.
shortened: You turned away from the wine of delusion and became intoxicated with the choice sealed wine. You took the cup of salvation from the hand of the Cup-bearer of the Covenant and became inebriated with supreme joy, delight and longing upon beholding the lights of the Daystar of the horizons.

order.why: Keep the counsel to set aside vain imaginings.
Retain the account of reception amid veiling, including the source’s encoding.
shortened: Yet when the light of divinity shone forth from the horizon of Oneness, all were occupied with their own vain desires and remained afar from Himâ€"save those souls who drank deep of the choice wine of inner meanings from the hand of divine bounty.

order.why: Hear the lament of an open feast left unreceived.
Keep hatred outside the offered crimson cup.
shortened: Hearken, O My loved ones, unto the melody of grandeur, then drink ye of the water of everlasting life. We have forbidden the people of hatred from this crimson cup from the hand of the All-Glorious Cup-bearer. Thus hath the matter been decreed by your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

order.why: Approach the sealed wine with complete detachment.
Read endurance and detachment as qualities of reception.
shortened: This divine nectar hath not been, nor shall be, the portion of every soul. This wine is befitting only to enduring souls and detached hearts, and ever shall be.

order.why: Receive the bounty of immortality amid repudiation.
Preserve the warning against being turned away.
shortened: O people! Drink of the choice wine of the All-Glorious before the great cry is raised, lest the whisperings of Satan affect you and prevent you from attaining the good-pleasure of God, the Mighty, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Retain the source’s contrast of enduring and perishable life.
shortened: Whosoever today has drunk of this eternal wine has attained eternal life, and whosoever has been deprived is accounted as among perishable forms in the sight of God.

order.why: Set eternal life against worldly defeat and passing.
shortened: The end is nothingness, and in the battle array there is defeat - unless you drink a cup of the wine of eternal life and taste the honey of everlasting existence, and become confirmed with a spirit that bestows eternal life.

order.why: Let wine’s warmth meet the fire of attraction.
Keep baptismal water, fire and Spirit together.
Read the cup through Sinai and the return from a swoon.
shortened: The Cup-Bearer of 'Ama offers the goblet of the wine of faithfulness with radiant light, that ye may become enraptured in the Sinai of love through the manifestation of Beauty, and after attaining unto "when he recovered from his swoon," ye may hear from the tongue of the heart the blessed verse "And to God belongeth the Kingdom of the heavens and of the earth," that ye may enter, intoxicated, into the gathering of love and the assembly of affection and become thankful.

order.why: Retain the related movement from guidance to the Tree’s call.
shortened: Praise be to Him Who passed round the cups of guidance in the gathering of the people of fidelity, and gave them to drink of the wine of bounty until they became intoxicated with the sweet nectar, and spoke in praise, and were drawn to the luminous garden, and derived light from the fire kindled in the Tree of Sinai, and heard the call of God from that green Tree, and fell unconscious in the place of revelation near the Most Holy Sanctuary.

order.why: Gather steadfast friends at the feast of the Covenant.
shortened: Thou didst grant us shelter beneath the companionable tree, didst prepare the feast of "Am I not?", didst make us drunk from the cup of the Covenant, and didst gather these friends among the company of the steadfast ones.
You must, day and night, through the confirmations of the Intended Lord, arrange gatherings of firmness and steadfastness, and make souls drunk and bewildered with the wine of the Covenant.

order.why: Name cup, wine and Cupbearer within that setting.
shortened: Its chalice is the primal, timeless Cup of Alast; its wine is the crimson Wine of the Supreme Covenant; its Cupbearer is the Abha Beauty. Its cup is brimming over, its wine most choice, and its Cupbearer the Rose-cheeked Beauty.
Be ye intoxicated! Be ye wine-worshippers! Take ye the chalice in hand! Be ye filled with fervor and rapture! This is the most pure Wine! This is the crystal Cup! This is the Resurrection!

The spiritual ones are intoxicated from this Wine, and they who are filled with the divine spirit have quaffed their fill and are inebriated from this overflowing Cup with the bounteous gifts of Baha.

order.why: Connect fidelity with the feast of Alast.
shortened: From the hand of the Cup-bearer of eternity thou hast drunk the chalice of fidelity, and at the feast of "Am I not?" thou hast become inebriated.

order.why: Preserve the fervent call to receive at the feast.
Keep the wandering lover’s poetic invitation.
Define the offered wine through steadfastness in servitude.
Join the Covenant’s exhilaration to a lover’s burning.
Retain both the source fragment and the wine of steadfastness.
shortened: From the wine of divine love in this luminous morn.
The splendor shining from the heaven of My mercy be upon thee and upon My chosen ones who have quaffed the wine of steadfastness from the hands of the bounty of their Lord, the Generous.

order.why: Bless the friends’ shared participation.
shortened: Blessed are those souls who are intoxicated from this cup, and blessed are the friends who are full of spirit and fragrance from the chalice of the Covenant.

order.why: Let gratitude for the Covenant lead to serving as a bearer.
Recognize truth and righteousness within the addressed Persian community.
Let an illumined community become a constant feast of love and knowledge.
Recognize parents within the imagery of the feast.
Keep the named servant beneath the Covenant’s banner.
shortened: Verily this servant of Thine, who is named 'Ali, hath gathered beneath the banner of the Covenant and drunk the choice wine of Thy love from an overflowing cup.

order.why: Pray for both firm resolve and restless love.
shortened: I am falling and rising in Your path, intoxicated with the wine of the Covenant.

O Lord! Grant me power, make me firm and steadfast, make me restless and impatient, make me mad with love for Your resplendent Beauty, make me enthralled by that musk-laden tress, until we forget stranger and kin alike and surge and roar like the sea, becoming intoxicated and bewildered from the cup of the Covenant.

order.why: Join knowledge with standing firm in trial.
Read the sustaining wine amid shaken certainties.
shortened: Thou beholdest how the tempestuous winds of tests have caused the steadfast in faith to tremble, and how the breath of trials hath stirred up those whose hearts had been firmly established, except such as have partaken of the Wine that is life indeed from the hands of the Manifestation of Thy name, the Most Merciful.

order.why: Hear the cup of tribulation as a difficult expression of love.
Keep the vivid reported banquet of trials in its own context.
Join the winehouse of trials with giving a drop to the earth.
shortened: Now His loved ones also receive a share and portion from His wine-house of tribulation.
When you drink the wine, sprinkle a drop upon the earth, for the earth has a share from the cup of the noble ones.

order.why: Retain gratitude within the addressed experience of persecution.
Pray for the friends of Nayríz in their history of sacrifice.
shortened: However, with heart and soul I constantly sigh and lament at the divine threshold and seek boundless aid and grace for the spiritual friends, especially for the loved ones of Nayriz who, praise be to God, are brimming and overflowing with the wine of the love of God, and who [in the path of the Blessed Beauty] have traversed every valley and each day sacrificed their lives.

order.why: Keep the longing to participate in the gathering of sacrifice.
shortened: Would that I had been with them and become intoxicated from that wine and drunk from that cup which overflowed with the wine of God's gift in the gathering of sacrifice!

order.why: Preserve the poem’s demanding image of offering heart and soul.
Let the winehouse of servitude shape the speaker’s own description.
Name love for other servants as a source of intoxication.
Let separation reveal a thirst only reunion can answer.
shortened: Thou well knowest, O my God, my Best-Beloved, that naught can quench the thirst I suffer in my separation from Thee except the waters of Thy presence, and that the tumult of my heart can never be stilled save through the living fountain of my reunion with Thee. Send down, then, upon me, O my Lord, out of the heaven of Thy bounty what will draw me nearer unto the chalice of Thy gifts, and make me able to quaff the choice sealed Wine, whose seal hath been loosed in Thy name, and from Which the sweet savors of Thy days have been shed abroad.

order.why: Keep affectionate longing alive within an assurance about the absent friend.
shortened: Although I know that wheresoever thou art, and by whatsoever cup inebriated, thou hast taken thy repose beside a flask of the wine of inner meaning, and art intoxicated by the vintage of the love of God, yet this yearning on the one hand, and the expectation of the receipt of news on the other, are difficult to bear.

order.why: Ask how attraction becomes remembrance.
shortened: And how can I fail to make mention of Thee after Thy most sweet call hath attracted me and the wine of the Kawthar of Thy love hath intoxicated me?

order.why: Pray to enter the tavern of love through grace.
Ask nourishment through knowledge and love.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the sighs which they whose souls pant after Thee have uttered in their remoteness from Thy court, and by the cries of such of Thy lovers as bemoan their separation from Thee, to nourish me with the wine of Thy knowledge and the living waters of Thy love and pleasure.

order.why: Join wine of grace with waters of loving-kindness.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of eternity and Educator of the world, to give me to drink of the choice wine of grace from the hands of Thy bounty and the living waters of loving-kindness from the fingers of Thy favor.

order.why: Pray for freedom from vain imaginings.
shortened: Thou seest how I have turned myself toward Thee, and set my face in the direction of Thy grace and Thy gifts. I implore Thee, by Thy name through which Thou didst enable all them that have recognized Thy unity to partake of the wine of Thy mercy, and all such as have drawn nigh unto Thee to quaff the living waters of Thy loving-kindness, to rid me entirely of all vain imaginings, and to incline me in the direction of Thy grace, O Thou Who art the Lord of all men!

order.why: Seek eyes open to beauty and ears attentive to the dove.
shortened: I beseech Thee, by Thy Most Great Name, to open the eyes of Thy servants, that they may behold Thee shining above the horizon of Thy majesty and glory, and that they may not be hindered by the croaking of the raven from hearkening to the voice of the Dove of Thy sublime oneness, nor be prevented by the corrupt waters from partaking of the pure wine of Thy bounty and the everlasting streams of Thy gifts.

order.why: Ask for sight and joy in a dark night.
shortened: O Lord, enlighten my sight by beholding Thy lights in this dark night, and make me happy by the wine of Thy love in this wonderful age.

order.why: Connect exhilaration with the removal of estrangement.
shortened: Remove estrangement and confer unity. Give us to drink from the cup of crimson wine, and cause us to taste the draught of the Concourse on High. Make us intoxicated and enraptured; make us flourishing and prosperous.

order.why: Seek shelter and nearness through the cup of bounty.
shortened: O Lord! I beseech Thee by the Most Great Word whereby all who are in earth and heaven were seized with terror, save those who held fast to the Sure Handle, that Thou leave me not among Thy creatures, but raise me up unto Thee and cause me to enter beneath the shadow of Thy mercy and give me to drink of the pure wine of Thy bounty, that I may dwell in the pavilion of Thy glory and the canopies of Thy favors.

order.why: Let the ark and ocean widen the prayer’s imagery.
Include loved ones and their children in the prayer for nearness.
Retain the prayer’s charged imagery of revelation and certitude.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the Most Great Name through which every misbeliever lamented, and every denier cried out, and every infidel perished, to make me of those who have drunk the wine of revelation from the hand of Thy bounty and who have soared on the wings of certitude to the heaven of Thy Cause.

order.why: Ask awakening from torpor and release from fetters.
shortened: O Lord! Free me from these chains and fetters, draw me unto the Kingdom of Beauty, breathe into me the spirit of life, expand my breast through manifest signs, resurrect me from the grave of torpor, awaken me from the couch of slumber, illumine mine eye with the vision of lights, cause me to hear the songs of birds, gather me with the righteous ones, and let me drink from the cup of the pure ones until I become intoxicated with the wine of mysteries.

order.why: Let praise and remembrance express the prayed-for joy.
shortened: "Then intoxicate me with the wine of Thy love, so that I may attain to success and prosperity in this dawn of Light; may speak Thy praises, call upon Thy Name, be engaged in Thy commemoration in this vast country and spacious continent and be inebriated with the pure Wine which is glowing in the excellent Cup.

order.why: Offer the wine of pardon to named friends.
Keep the related gifts of forgiveness and Covenant.
shortened: Give Isfandiyar Surush a cup of the wine of forgiveness to drink, and make Zarbanu Nush intoxicated and bewildered from the cup of the Covenant.

order.why: Join the wine with Sinai’s fire in a prayer for guidance.
shortened: O thou who art advancing to the Kingdom of God!

Verily, I pray God to make thee the sign of guidance among the maid-servants of the Merciful, to enkindle in thy heart a spark of that fire which was ignited in the Sinaitic Tree and to give thee to drink an overflowing cup from the choice wine of the love of God, until the intoxication of that wine may so prevail upon thee that thou mayest thereby forget all else save God, be attracted to the Beauty of God, glorify thy Lord and sanctify Him during morn and eve.

order.why: Ask for reunion and steadfastness together.
shortened: O God! Bahram-i-Khusraw yearned for Thy path, and spread his wings that he might behold Thy face and soar toward Thee. O Lord! Thou art forgiving and kind. Grant him forgiveness, bestow rest upon him, and give him tranquility at Thy threshold. Make him intoxicated with the wine of reunion and make him steadfast.

order.why: Preserve the faithful servant’s attraction in prayer.
Seek lasting joy and shelter.
shortened: Grant this fallen servant eternal joy from the prepared wine of Your wine-house, and bestow everlasting delight and rapture, so that he may find rest in the shelter of Your court and be immersed in the ocean of lights.

order.why: Let the praying servant yearn beyond other attachments.
shortened: This servant who is intoxicated with the brimming cup of Thy love, and who, at the feast of longing, with goblet in hand, yearns for Thy path and seeks Thy beauteous face, is detached from all else but Thee and restless in his love for the One Beloved.

order.why: Pray that joy becomes a lamp among believers.
Remember departed servants through love and the mysteries they heard.
Praise insight and ask to share the same gift.
shortened: Well done to thee for having chosen insight over blindness, for having witnessed the greatest signs of thy Lord, for having sought shelter in the shade of the Ultimate Tree, for having taken refuge in the most secure cave, for having attained the most abundant portion, for having won the highest cup, and for having drunk a brimming goblet overflowing with the wine of the love of God.
Lord! Give me to drink of that wine and grant me the cup of Thy bounty which is the intoxication of those pure, distinguished and noble ones, by Thy greatest mercy.

order.why: Connect revelation’s wine with divine love.
shortened: Blessed art thou for having drunk the choice wine of revelation and attained unto the love of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

order.why: Keep recognition within an addressed blessing to a woman.
shortened: O handmaiden of God! Praise be to God that through divine bestowals and heavenly bounties thou hast attained recognition of the Manifestation of Mysteries and hast turned toward the Dawning-place of Revelation and the Rising-point of Inspiration, and hast partaken of the sealed wine, with a single drop of which none in existence can compare.

order.why: Let a response of yes become an account of longing.
