shortened: This is Thy servant whom Thou hast called unto Thy most exalted Self, and who responded with "yea" and soared in the atmosphere of yearning and longing in Thy love and good-pleasure until he drank the choice sealed wine from the hands of Thy bounty.

order.why: Gather hearing, responding, obeying and remembrance.
shortened: Verily he who hath turned unto Him hath turned unto My direction and appeared before My throne and heard My call and responded to My utterance and followed My commandments and attained My presence and drunk the choice wine of My favors and the Kawthar of My bounties and tasted the sweetness of My remembrance and My words and reached the ultimate goal in My Kingdom and My dominion.

order.why: Extend rejoicing and recognition to all created things.
Retain the testimony concerning those who have drunk.
Recall turning toward the horizon amid a trembling world.
shortened: Well is it with thee for having drunk the Choice Wine sealed with My Self-Subsisting Name, and for having turned toward the Supreme Horizon on a Day wherein the limbs of all names trembled.

order.why: Thank God for recognition and remembrance in the prison.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having enabled me to recognize the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thy knowledge, and for having given me to drink of the wine of Thy bounty in such wise that I have turned my face unto Thy face and been honored by Thy favors to such extent that Thou hast mentioned me in Thy Most Great Prison.

order.why: Keep the stated fulfillment of earlier scriptural promise.
Preserve the compact blessing on the people of Bahá.
shortened: Glory be upon the people of Baha who have drunk, in My Name, the Sealed Wine.

order.why: Let enduring life become a cause of joy.
shortened: Joy be unto thee for having drunk the wine of everlasting life from the hands of the bounty of thy Lord, the Most Merciful.

order.why: Distinguishes enduring spiritual intoxication from passing physical enjoyment.
Join wine with the Kawthar of presence.
Retain the Pen’s testimony of divine knowledge.
shortened: My Supreme Pen testifieth that thou hast quaffed the choice wine of divine knowledge from the hands of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, and hast attained unto that which was inscribed in the Books of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

order.why: Keep the blessing on those receiving life from the Youth.
shortened: Glory and splendor be upon Thee and upon them who have drunk the water of life from the hand of the Youth.

order.why: Hear the cup itself call out joy.
Preserve the source’s demanding account of turning and separation.
Let the heavenly table and cup express a gift beyond description.
Receive the playful address to Núsh within the symbolic feast.
shortened: O Nush, wine-drinker! May this cup of wine be sweet to you! This wine is the handiwork of that veiled Beloved.

order.why: Retain the brief blessing of love and bestowals.
Bless the recipient of the Cupbearer’s grace.
shortened: O joy to the one who in this time hath drunk the cup of everlasting life from the hand of the Cup-bearer of grace!

order.why: Join pilgrimage, thanksgiving and attraction to character.
shortened: O seekers of the beauty of the All-Glorious, O pilgrims of the exalted Kaaba of the transcendent Lord! With utmost joy, delight and gladness, engage in thanksgiving to the All-Merciful Lord, that you have found your way to His path and hastened toward Him and witnessed the radiance of His countenance and become intoxicated by His musk-scented breeze.
You have drunk from His heart-attracting stream and become enamored of His character and disposition.

order.why: Remember nurture from childhood within guidance and concord.
shortened: O blessed leaf! Give thanks to the Ancient Beauty and the Ever-Living Almighty that from the beginning of life you grew and developed under the shade of the Tree of Sinai, and drank the wine of the love of God from the hand of the Cup-bearer of guidance, and came under the protection and chastity of one who is the Herald of the Covenant and the Raiser of the Banner of Concord, who is the Lamp of the spiritual gathering and the Sign of the mercy of the Lord God.

order.why: Connect gratitude with knowledge and the kingdom’s attraction.
Let receiving mysteries move an assembly to joy.
Acknowledge the limits of any thanksgiving.
shortened: Even if thou shouldst open a hundred mouths, and in each mouth were a hundred tongues to give thanks for this bestowal of the Lord of creation - that praise be to God, thou hast drunk the cup of guidance from the hand of the Cup-bearer of bounty and become intoxicated with the wine of the love of God - thou wouldst still fall short and be unable.

order.why: Join the cup with refinement and witnessing.
shortened: Attain to the station of witnessing, for you have become cherished maidservants at the Divine Threshold, have become cultured and refined, and have become intoxicated and ecstatic from the overflowing cup.

order.why: Thank the friend who gave guidance.
Share the blessing between two recipients.
shortened: Well is it with thee and with him for this cup that brimmeth over with the wine of the love of God.

order.why: Retain the brief recognition of love received.
Give thanks for seeing after the covering is removed.
shortened: O thou fragrant rose blooming in the Garden of Guidance!

Thank thou God for that He hath removed from off thine eye the covering, made thee to see the signs of the Kingdom of thy Lord, the Supreme, filled for thee the cup of bounty and gave thee to drink the pure wine of fidelity which He hath promised to the sincere in the holy Books and Tablets.

order.why: Keep the poetic felicitation of lovers in the tavern.
shortened: Happy are ye who are intoxicated from the cup of His favor! Happy are ye who worship the wine in the tavern of His love!

order.why: Let hope’s cup overflow with bounty.
Extend gladness to all loved ones.
shortened: Happy am I and all my loved ones for this cup overflowing with the choice wine of God's grace, dripping with the pure water of God's gifts!"

order.why: Preserve the address to one filled with ecstasy.
Recognize two recipients entering the path of guidance.
Keep grace and favor within the image of drinking.
Give thanks for the guided path.
Let the heart itself be the overflowing cup.
shortened: O faithful servant of the Most Glorious Beauty! Give thanks to God that through the bounty of guidance, you have illumined a face like unto the radiant moon, and filled the cup of your heart to overflowing with the wine of the love of God.

order.why: Imagine fuller awareness of favor as a flight into gladness.
Retain the blessing on the overflowing cup.
shortened: Thou hast drunk a brimming cup from the hand of the Lord of the Righteous and become awake and aware, for this wine increaseth reason and knowledge, and bestoweth understanding and insight. It openeth the eye and unsealeth the ear and maketh the heart perceive.
Well is it with thee to have this cup which overfloweth with the wine of the love of God.

order.why: Gather guidance, sweetness and recognition in thanksgiving.
Let the distant recipient share in the same fervor.
Recognize a friend as an intimate of mysteries.
shortened: Immediately it occurred to me that that dear one is intoxicated from the overflowing cup of the wine of grace and is the confidant of divine mysteries in the private chamber of the Desired One.

order.why: Keep the gift’s language of a shared portion.
shortened: O servant of God! Know the worth of this noble father who guided you to the living waters and directed you to the abode of the Beloved. He gave you a portion of the heavenly feast and bestowed upon you a share of the divine wine.

order.why: Let the wine’s effect become an alchemy of a person’s condition.
Describe the new life as alive, free and fresh.
Join renewed life with love and truth.
Let steadfastness and song awaken others.
shortened: I fervently supplicate God to bring assurance to your souls and to raise you up with such steadfastness that each of you may withstand an entire nation. May you become so inebriated with the wine of the love of God that ye may cause your hearers to dance with blissful rapture to the song and melody of the love of God.

order.why: Keep the promise of a changed joy within the heart.
shortened: Until man becomes free and pure from this heavy burden of the earthly world, he will not receive any portion from the Kingdom and will not attain joy and delight. The intoxication of that wine brings another passion to the head and manifests another joy in the heart.

order.why: Pray for increasing gladness.
Let affection sustain continuing participation.
Guard the pearl from attachment so its light and joy increase.
Receive a portion from the boundless ocean.
shortened: The divine wine must be drunk pure, and may you too receive a portion from this boundless ocean and take a share from this limitless sea.

order.why: Retain the counsel about unmixed wine and its source omission.
Preserve the difficult ring-stone image as supplied in the source.
shortened: Send greeting to the maid-servant of God, Miss ..., and say: "As the love of God hath the utmost penetration in thy heart, the ring-stone bearing the strong wine, for capacity is great and the power of the wine is intense. Therefore, there wilt not remain any power or resistance."

order.why: Keep the paradoxical pairing of explanation with senselessness.
Let the explicit jest turn forgetfulness and madness inside out.
shortened: This statement is by way of jest, otherwise there is no doubt that souls who are intoxicated from the divine cup of "Am I not?" and are wine-worshippers in the tavern of the Friend are always drinking to the memory of the Beloved's face, and from the wine of the love of the Lord they, like an overflowing cup, forget forgetfulness and consider silence as unconsciousness, count forgetting as disobedience, and call occupation with aught else sheer madness.

order.why: Preserve the poem’s paradox of never awakening from truth.
shortened:
The one drunk with wine awakens from the west wind,
But the one drunk with Truth awakens not even from the trumpet of resurrection.

order.why: Keep the interrupted banquet description visibly incomplete.
Choose an object of love amid the world’s competing desires.
shortened: O soul enamored of the Countenance of the Self-Subsisting! In this world of upheaval, where every head harbors a desire and every heart yearns for a beloved, if thou art a living soul and a soaring spirit, become enchanted by the Face of the All-Merciful, become disheveled by the tresses of the Beloved, and become intoxicated and inebriated with the wine of God.

order.why: Turn tears and longing toward the offered gift.
Seek satisfaction at the spring of life through the mystic cup.
Keep Núshírván’s merciful love and the source’s omission visible.
Retain the brief appeal to ask for the wine.
shortened: Ask God that you may become intoxicated with this wine and become a wine-worshipper in this tavern.

order.why: Take up the cup of inner meanings.
shortened: If you were to comprehend the greatness of this gift, you would soar aloft from sheer joy, and like a candle would shine forth in the niche of gladness and set the world ablaze with the fire of the love of God.
You would take up the divine cup and become intoxicated with the wine of inner meanings. You would drink and give others to drink, and cause a world to cry out in ecstasy.

order.why: Join receiving with seeking help.
shortened: O servant of God! Be intoxicated with the cup of the All-Merciful and seek the aid and bounty of the Lord.

order.why: Fill purity’s cup with faithfulness.
Let the weeping decanter’s joy become a call to arise.
Hear the repeated invitation to gladness.
Keep the collective joy of those who share the tavern.
Pause over the brief naming of spirit and fragrance.
shortened: It is the spirit and sweet fragrance and the intoxication of the pure wine from the wine-cellar of the Beloved.

order.why: Retain the wine-seller’s own transformation.
Let the renewed friend become a nightingale.
shortened: Now that peerless friend has, praise be to God, become intoxicated with the wine of the divine cup and has become the nightingale of the rose garden of mysteries.

order.why: Read music and thanksgiving as expressions of the feast.
shortened: Praise and glorification are due, that we may offer thanksgiving and until the melody and song and the music of harp and drum and the intoxicated inclinations manifest the effect of nightly wine-drinking.

order.why: Give the poetic garden an exuberant ensemble of voices.
Let song and laughter stir the listener.
Become a singer of joy through the cup’s imagery.
Join attentive listening with the gift of gladness.
Make the recipient responsible to act and serve as Cupbearer.
shortened: Thou must henceforth, God willing, act in accordance with that which thou hast been commanded and be the cup-bearer of this immortal wine. This is the most great bounty which hath flowed forth from the ancient ocean. Drink thou therefrom and be of the thankful ones.

order.why: Offer the received portion to seekers.
shortened: Therefore, you who have received a share and portion from this abundant bounty and found a full measure of this great grace must, like wine-loving cupbearers, become intoxicated and enchanted, and taking this divine cup in hand, give the seekers of the primordial covenant the divine wine to drink, and give the yearning lovers of the Beauty of the All-Merciful news of the loveliness and radiance of the Ancient Countenance, so that each may look with the eye of insight and see that the divine Joseph has appeared with such splendor in the divine Egypt that it has broken the market value of a hundred thousand Josephs of Canaan, and has lit such a countenance that it has caused tumult in the city and raised the banner of commotion at the pole of the horizons.

order.why: Pass around both love and joy.
Share the precious meanings rather than keeping them.
shortened: Therefore you must take up this cup of divine wine, shatter the market of the heedless, and scatter these precious meanings upon all.

order.why: Let a bearer awaken enthusiasm in others.
shortened: Soon he will take in hand the overflowing cup of the love of God, and intoxicated in the gathering of the All-Merciful, will become the cupbearer of the wine of the primordial covenant and a wine-lover, becoming the cause of enthusiasm and rapture.

order.why: Imagine a community transformed through love.
shortened: Make all intoxicated with the wine of alast and give them free rein in the arena of the love of God, so that the homeland of the Greatest Name - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - may become an example of the Supreme Concourse and manifest the light of the Abha Kingdom.

order.why: Recognize the cup held in the recipients’ hands.
shortened: Ye hold in your hands the goblet of supreme guidance and are inebriated with the crimson wine of the love of the Blessed Beauty.

order.why: Join the wine of love to the fire of Paran.
shortened: From the cup of the wine of love for the Most Great Name thou hast become intoxicated and enchanted, and from the fire kindled on Mount Paran thou hast been set ablaze and ignited.

order.why: Sing so others may also be moved.
Retain the account of knowledge under the sovereignty of love.
shortened: Thou hast become intoxicated with the wine of divine knowledge and overcome by the Sovereign upon the throne of love.

order.why: Share both water and wine from divine bounty.
Make deeds an invitation to transformed conduct.
Offer others the joy of the Morn of Eternity.
shortened: Cause them to drink from the cup of the wine of the Morn of Eternity and intoxicate them with the goblet of everlasting felicity.

order.why: Offer the cup to everyone.
shortened: With one hand you may upraise the heavenly Banner and with the other hand, may you hold the overflowing cup with the Wine of the Love of God, offering it to all and exhilarating everyone with its spiritual nectar.

order.why: Keep drinking and sharing inseparable.
shortened: However, for the pure soul there is a sublime paradise - a heavenly world. That pavilion is higher than Saturn and its breadth and expanse is endless. Seek that, and take up the jeweled cup and drink and share the divine wine.

order.why: Let knowledge refresh seekers’ hearts.
Retain the concise act of offering to the thirsty.
shortened: They have no rest day or night - they surge forth and cry out, awakening the slumbering ones and making the heedless ones mindful. They take up the cup and intoxicate the thirsty ones. They loose their tongues to truths and meanings and bestow heavenly bounties.

order.why: Pass the cup through a gathering of detachment.
shortened: O thou who art intoxicated with the wine of the love of the All-Merciful! Pass round the cup of attraction in the gathering of detachment, and make the loved ones drunk with the choice wine of divine election, and cause the near ones to be enraptured by the melodies of the Dove.

order.why: Read the reported image of teaching as wine.
Gather the movement in the call to take, drink and give.
Let the warming of knowledge lead to public invitation.
shortened: And when you have partaken of the chalices and the warmth of the wine of your Lord's knowledge has seized you, then greet the dawn, arise amidst the concourse of the earth and say: "To Me, to Me, O people of righteousness, that I may draw you nigh unto the Most Sublime Vision and cause you to know your Lord, the Ordainer of destiny, through Whom the sun was darkened and the moon was cleft asunder!"

order.why: Imagine a learned person as an eye for the world.
Set love and knowledge before all people.
Close the linked readings with a drop offered to the earth.
shortened: One thing remains, and it is this:
"When thou drinkest wine, sprinkle thou a drop upon the earth."
Therefore, in thanksgiving for this most great bounty and supreme favor, one must take the divine cup in hand and, dancing in the arena of sacrifice, bestow it upon all created things.

order.why: Retain the supplied invitation with its unresolved omissions.
Keep the supplied blessing and its incomplete ending.
Include the explicit supplied distinction between spiritual wine and intoxicants.
Read the supplied counsel on law through love, tolerance and wisdom.
Close with the Lotus Sutra’s distinct image of teaching as rain offered without discrimination.

questions: How do the passages distinguish spiritual exhilaration from diminished awareness, pride, and heedlessness?
What happens to the meaning of wine when it is associated with fairness, knowledge, revelation, the Covenant, or steadfast service?
How might joy coexist with longing or trial in these readings, and how do their particular settings affect your interpretation?
What do the Qur’anic scene of sealed wine and the Christian call to be filled with the Spirit illuminate, and where do their settings and purposes differ from this compilation?
How can poetic language that speaks of losing consciousness also invite greater discernment, and what helps a reader avoid flattening that paradox?
Which actions would make renewed joy visible to others, and how does becoming a bearer of the cup connect with the final image of rain offered to everyone?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 83:22–28 · Sealed wine and the spring of Tasnīm
references.note: Read the scene of the virtuous in bliss, with sealed wine, musk, and the spring of Tasnīm. Consider how these scriptural images are taken up and interpreted in the compilation, while retaining the Qur’anic passage’s own setting of promised reward.

references.label: 2 · Ephesians 5:15–21 · Awareness, song, and life in the Spirit
references.note: This passage connects wise living with being filled with the Spirit, singing, thanksgiving, and mutual submission, while cautioning against drunkenness. Compare its practical account of spiritual fullness with the compilation’s accounts of an exhilaration that heightens awareness and leads to service.

subjects.displayTitle: A source of light: wisdom made visible in service
subjects.introduction: A candle burns on what it is fed, and ‘Abdu’l-Bahá tells us the candle of the heart is fed with wisdom. Becoming a source of light is therefore not a matter of charm or temperament but the slow work of nourishing something inward until it cannot help but shine outward, as a refuge for the helpless, a cure for the ailing, a bringer of joy to someone else’s heart. Bahá’u’lláh asks His friends to be lamps unto a darkened world, and the lamp is known by its effects: trustworthiness that guides people, deeds that persuade where words cannot, patience with those slow to understand. Matthew’s lamp that lights the whole house and lets good works be seen is an older echo of the same conviction. From here the journey opens into service to others, into the golden rule and the care never to sadden another soul, and inward again along the spiritual path, where a person learns to tell guidance from mere desire through effort, intelligence, prayer and consultation.
subjects.arc: Begin with the oil of wisdom and concrete care; explore received light, character and prayer; move through education and patient local service toward discernment in one’s own decisions.

order.why: Make the image concrete through care for the vulnerable.
shortened: Be ye loving fathers to the orphan, and a refuge to the helpless, and a treasury for the poor, and a cure for the ailing. Be ye the helpers of every victim of oppression, the patrons of the disadvantaged. Think ye at all times of rendering some service to every member of the human race.

order.why: Open with the candle sustained by wisdom.
shortened: My counsel to you is: Never let the candle of your heart become extinct. Strive to increase its light. Add to it the oil of wisdom. Illumine every one with its rays.

order.why: Give light the meaning of bringing joy.
shortened: Never is it the wish of Abdu'l-Baha to see any being hurt, nor will He make anyone to grieve; for man can receive no greater gift than this, that he rejoice another's heart. I beg of God that ye will be bringers of joy, even as are the angels in Heaven.

order.why: Ask whom received blessings should benefit.
Test guidance through trustworthiness.
shortened: For example, if today a soul becomes successful in trustworthiness and manifests praiseworthy qualities and virtues, this will surely become the cause of guidance for people.

order.why: Name the qualities that give life radiance.
shortened: In brief, let each one of you be as a lamp shining forth with the light of the virtues of the world of humanity. Be trustworthy, sincere, affectionate and replete with chastity. Be illumined, be spiritual, be divine, be glorious, be quickened of God, be a Baha'i.

order.why: Let the hungry question what recipients will do.
Connect unity with meeting practical needs.
shortened: O thou maid-servant of God! The utmost desire of the lordly ones is the union of the friends, the agreement of the believers and the spiritual communication of the hearts; in order that they may shine in this darkened world like unto bright stars; educate all the communities of the world in the precepts of love; be kind and benevolent to every one, sympathetic and compassionate to all; to become the cool and pure water to every thirsty one, a heavenly table to every hungry one, a swift healing antidote to every sick one and the cause of the everlasting glory to every humiliated one.

order.why: Join character to service amid difficulty.
Give light a horizon of peace among peoples.
Read its urgency against enmity and war.
shortened: From one side there threatens the darkness of ignorance; from another side black enmity is visible; from the other side we hear of war and rumors of war. We must, like a candle, shine with the light of Baha'u'llah, in order that through your efforts this darkness may be dispelled. The light of the love of God can illumine the East and the West.

order.why: Gather the opening in the call to be lamps.
shortened: O friends! Be as lamps unto the darkened world and as light unto its gloom.

order.why: Distinguish sight, wisdom and guidance.
shortened: He said:

"The light is of four kinds: first, the light of the sun. It reveals objects to our perception, but cannot itself realize them. Second, the light of the eye. It can realize objects, but cannot understand them. Third, the light of wisdom. This both realizes and understand objects. Fourth, the Light of Guidance. This is the Supreme Light, the conscious Reality which comprehends mysteries."

order.why: Explore guidance encompassing the whole person.
Compare healing of body and spirit.
shortened: For guidance is the medicine of the spirit and the cause of spiritual victories - it is healing for the soul and a remedy of joy and delight for the heart. When wisdom shines with spiritual radiance it becomes guidance, and when its lights beam upon the body it becomes medicine.

Therefore, one who combines these two qualities and possesses these two virtues - which in essence are one reality but appear as two realities in relation to the spiritual and physical worlds - is a perfect person.

order.why: Keep the reported explanation of guidance as gift.
shortened: GOD did not create any evil thing. GOD did not create man poor. Poverty is only the lack of riches. Guidance is the Gift of GOD, and if a person is deprived of it, he will be misled, but he is not misled by GOD, it is only the lack of the Gift of Guidance.

order.why: Read guidance as the source of good.
Listen for guidance through all things.
Recognize the source of the offered beams.
shortened: O thou who art carried away by the love of God! The Sun of Truth hath risen above the horizon of this world and cast down its beams of guidance.

order.why: Retain the seal’s Lamp of Guidance.
Keep the named revelation’s saving lamp.
shortened: He hath made it the Lamp of Guidance amongst all created things and the Light of Salvation unto all who dwell within the realm of possibility.

order.why: Hear the call of certitude and knowledge.
shortened: Say: O people of the earth! The Sun of certitude hath risen, and the Ocean of knowledge surgeth, and the heaven of grace is uplifted. Cast away what ye possess, then turn toward the Most Sublime Horizon - the Station wherein the Lord of Names proclaimeth: "There is none other God but Me, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise."

order.why: See revelation through its own eye.
Follow protection, water and nearness.
Connect the path with human benefit.
Attend to the guiding word as lamp.
shortened: Fix your gaze upon and hold fast to this blessed word which is like a lamp in the darkness of the world.

order.why: Keep the protecting guide’s description.
Move from doubt toward certitude.
shortened: Praise be to God Who, through His all-encompassing mercy, guided His servants from the west of error to the east of guidance and caused them to attain from the darkness of doubt to the dawn of certitude. Therefore, blessed is the one who was illumined by this true dawn, and deprived is the soul who remained bereft and destitute.

order.why: Retain the distinction from heedlessness.
Acknowledge different responses to the path.
Keep the severe contrast of reception and refusal attributed.
shortened: They who have believed and been guided by God's guidance - these are they who are truly guided. And they who have disbelieved and turned away - these shall be brought forth in the fire. Thus hath it been ordained for this one and that, could ye but perceive with the eye of the spirit in all things.

order.why: Preserve the paired blessing and warning.
Read the source’s warning about blindness.
Consider weariness in searching for truth.
shortened: Therefore the people of the world seek truth in the realm of contingent existence rather than at the center. And when they find it not, they become captive to weariness and companion to woe.

order.why: Pray not to be left to oneself.
Give thanks for hearing through Sinai’s image.
shortened: Praise be to the Goal of the world that He guided thee and directed thee to the straight path. Thou hast heard what Moses heard upon the Mount.

order.why: Preserve the thanksgiving and omission.
shortened: Hearken in the Persian tongue: Give thanks unto the Purpose of the world and the Sovereign of nations Who hath confirmed thee and guided thee.
Verily He created thee and revealed thee and guided thee.

order.why: Receive the call as a gift to the heart.
Join guidance with the table of life.
shortened: Thanks be to God for having guided thee and proffered the cup of bestowal and sent down the heavenly table, of which whosoever partaketh shall never die.

order.why: Keep the assurance of divine assistance.
Define radiance through qualities expressed in every condition.
Let a name invite loving character.
Notice the influence of good conduct.
shortened: And now, I hope that thou shalt become the cause of the illumination of souls, so that they may acquire a heavenly nature, and that thy goodly character may exert its influence upon a vast number of people.

order.why: Make daily living a means of guidance.
Summon people toward good deeds.
Connect receiving counsel with awakening others.
Become adorned with spiritual attributes.
Cultivate qualities that make knowledge visible.
shortened: Adorn thyself with the characteristics of the spiritual ones and acquire the attributes of the cherubim, that the light of reality and the rays of divine knowledge may become manifest from thy countenance and the signs of bounty may shine forth.

order.why: Exchange triviality for wisdom.
Retain the reported question about life’s fruitfulness.
shortened: Man must so adorn himself with good attributes, attractions and divine characteristics that he may become the cause of the illumination of the world of humanity; otherwise his life will be a burden on him.

order.why: Let deeds evidence the teaching professed.
Follow the path into goodness and mercy.
Join following counsel with fruitfulness.
shortened: Arise and fulfil the admonitions of the Abha Beauty and follow the path of His counsels so that the glancing beams of thy spirit might illumine the world of humanity and thou mayest guide other souls, and may grow to be a fruit-laden tree in the garden of the All Glorious.

order.why: Bring the Hidden Words into action.
Join purification with education.
shortened: Purify and sanctify the heart so that the luminosity of the Word of God may shine forth within it, and engage in such deeds and actions as will cause the awakening and education of souls.
Therefore strive with your souls, take no rest, engage in service at the Sacred Threshold - and that is teaching the Cause of God and educating souls.

order.why: Explore purity through the mirror.
shortened: I hope that like this mirror you will make hearts pure and clean and sanctified so that they may reflect the lights of the perfections and bounties of the Sun of Truth.

order.why: Pray to become sign and mirror.
Keep servitude beside beauty.
shortened: O illumined candle! You have kindled a countenance of supreme beauty and grace.
As long as the dust of servitude at the Sacred Threshold adorns face and hair, the radiance of beauty emanates brilliantly from human features.

order.why: Let others perceive love’s warmth.
Walk so others witness love.
shortened: Melt away the darkening clouds of the world through the heat of His remembrance and walk in the expansive atmosphere of His will, in such wise that each of the handmaidens may witness in thee the signs of the love of God.

order.why: Read baptism through knowledge and character.
Join steadfastness with composure in trials.
Pray for constancy in the Covenant.
shortened: This befits you, and I beseech God to make you signs of guidance among mankind, to grant you steadfastness and firmness in the Kingdom of God and constancy in the Covenant of God.

order.why: Keep fidelity and confirmation together.
Seek firmness in guiding others.
shortened: Through His all-encompassing favors, it is hoped that day by day you will increase in steadfastness and firmness and become the cause of guidance for the blind and deaf.

order.why: Connect constancy, truth and song.
shortened: Show forth constancy that you may become a lamp of guidance. Become a herald of truth that you may hear the melody of the Kingdom. Become a sweet-singing bird that you may bring hearts into motion.

order.why: Let faithfulness become shared light.
shortened: Let us all become candles of faithfulness that burn for Him! Let us shed His light of guidance all around!

order.why: Keep the candle within fidelity to the Covenant.
shortened: Day and night kindle the fire of love and like a candle with tearful eyes burn in the fire of the love of God, until from your kindling and burning, lights may shine forth upon those regions and the banner of the Covenant may wave over those horizons.

order.why: Hold burning and contentment together.
shortened: The hope from the favors of the Glorious Lord is that you may have a countenance illumined by the lights of the Kingdom, and that in this world of mortality you may become the cause of the spread of heavenly bounties, and in this dusty realm of evanescence you may kindle a luminous lamp and burn away the veils of vain imaginings, and raise high the banner under the Divine Word, and burn and be content with the kindled fire of the Lord.

order.why: Keep purity in the brazier’s image.
shortened: Thou art the enkindled brazier of the Fire of Love and a lamp in the utmost purity, through which the Light of God's attraction shines forth.

order.why: Ask that radiance endure and refresh others.
shortened: Therefore, since thou hast been enkindled with the love of God, thou art radiant, brilliant and effulgent.

Beseech God that thou mayest ever remain illumined and that through the holy fragrances thou mayest perfume the nostrils of others, so that thou mayest become an embodied spirit, a personified light, and a manifest bounty.

order.why: Pray directly for light to illumine hearts.
Join the star with a remedy for wounds.
shortened: Make him a brilliant star and a radiant orb. Make him a remedy for every ill and a healing balm for every wound. Make him a bright candle in every gathering and a sweet-singing nightingale in every assembly.

order.why: Let remembered affection renew prayer.
Hear nightly supplication for faithful companions.
Gather candle, tree and bird in prayer.
Let stars become fruitful trees.
shortened: O Lord! Make them brilliant stars and radiant lamps, and towering trees, that their fruits may spread forth in the garden of divine traces, and through them the hearts of the free may be drawn to the Kingdom of Beauty.

order.why: Ask for sight and attentive hearing.
shortened: Illumine his eyes by beholding Thy signs that art latent in the realities of all things, delight his ears by the melodies of the birds of faithfulness in the garden of Thine eternity, and make him a sign of Thy remembrance amidst mankind and the banner of guidance on the far side of the valley.

order.why: Turn the whole being toward harmony.
shortened: O thou who art attracted by the Word of God to the Kingdom of God!

Turn with the whole of thy being to God, forget aught else save God, and supplicate God to make thee a sign of guidance in the midst of people who are veiled from God; perchance they may be guided to the Orb of all horizons, enter the kingdom of harmony, drink of the cup of the love of God, rejoice at the manifestation of the Kingdom of God, taste the delight of the mention of God, and shelter themselves in the shadow of the Tree of Life in the midst of the Paradise of God.

order.why: Retain the forceful stars-and-missiles image.
Keep severe protective imagery in its prayer.
shortened: O Lord! Deliver them from the evil of the people of error, immerse them in the sea of supplication and entreaty, and make them fountains of guidance, lamps in the darkest night, brilliant and luminous stars, and missiles against the people of misguidance and perversity.

order.why: Pray to kindle guidance in hearts.
shortened: Make me severed from the world and void of its conditions, attracted by the fragrances of Thy holiness among Thy maid-servants, free in heart, happy in soul, cheerful in mind, longing for the Kingdom of Thy Beauty, and glowing with the fire of Thy love in the world. Thus may I enkindle the light of guidance in the hearts of Thy servants.

order.why: Retain fire, fragrance and the supplied bracket.
Become a means of hearing and sight.
shortened: Therefore, O thou who circlest round the Concourse on High, beseech God to grant thee such a station that the grace of hearing and sight may flow from thee to other souls.

order.why: Extend prayer to humanity.
Keep the brief petition for guidance.
shortened: I beseech God to make ye the signs of guidance amidst mankind.

order.why: Widen that petition to all peoples.
Offer guidance in every condition.
Keep the prayer addressed to Shoghi.
Carry faithfulness into the gathering.
shortened: And from the threshold of the favors of that Kind Beloved and Goal of both worlds, I beg and hope that He may make each of those friends a bright candle and a light of the gathering and a flower of the rose garden and meadow, so that from each one, by the grace of the Most Glorious Beauty, the sweet fragrance of faithfulness may be inhaled.

order.why: Pray for enduring effects.
shortened: Grant such an outpouring that its lights may spread in the eternal morn; bestow such a grace that its effects may become renowned in the everlasting realm.

order.why: Let eternal life widen the horizon.
shortened: I entreat and supplicate in the Threshold of the Almighty and ask for your confirmation and assistance, that you may be born wholly out of the physical world into the Realm of Divine, to seek after the eternal life and wish for the everlasting gift, so that you may shine upon ages and cycles like unto the morning star!

order.why: Retain the demanding language of sacrifice.
Hear a gathering remembered at midnight.
shortened: My hope is that your gathering may become a divine assembly, and at midnight when I offer prayers, I supplicate at the divine threshold on your behalf so that the moments may be encompassed by His all-embracing favor and you may become children of God's Kingdom and manifestations of the knowledge of God, drink from the fountain of eternal life, and shine forth in the assemblage of the world such that you may breathe the spirit of eternal life into their hearts.

order.why: Let two friends become shared joy.
Keep the particular prayer for Persian friends.
shortened: Praise be to God that the Persian friends are heavenly angels, intoxicated with the wine of gladness. I beseech God that they may become the light of hearts and bestow self-sacrifice upon souls, that they may become like laughing hundred-petaled roses in the heavenly garden and flowing cypresses by the stream of knowledge.

order.why: Recall mercy and removed affliction.
shortened: Through them the brilliant stars grew dim on the darkest night, and the lights of truth shone forth in the darkened regions. Through them Thou hast caused the fountains of wisdom to flow forth, and through them Thou hast removed sorrow, manifested bounty, dispelled wrath, extended mercy, bestowed gifts and removed affliction.

order.why: Join acquired knowledge with understanding.
shortened: It is incumbent upon thee to acquire the various branches of knowledge, and to turn thy face toward the beauty of the Manifest Beauty, that thou mayest be a sign of saving guidance amongst the peoples of the world, and a focal center of understanding in this sphere from which the wise and their wisdom are shut out, except for those who set foot in the Kingdom of lights and become informed of the veiled and hidden mystery, the well-guarded secret.

order.why: Connect dawn prayer with alertness.
shortened: Strive with all thy power in prayers and communions at the hour of dawn to increase thine alertness day by day, to strip away the misgivings that veil the people of doubt and lead them towards the Most Great Guide with the potent knowledge of God so that like unto a candle thou mayest illuminate every meeting with the light of recognition.

order.why: Use evidence to dispel suspicions.
Become a teacher of love.
Explore education through seed and gardener.
Read the analogy of education and healing.
Respond to immaturity with kindness.
shortened: At most it is this, that some souls are ignorant, they must be educated; some are sick, they must be healed; some are still of tender age, they must be helped to attain maturity, and the utmost kindness must be shown to them. This is the conduct of the people of Baha.

order.why: Refuse to abandon those needing patient explanation.
shortened: In any case, guide the weak souls to the divine Covenant with utmost kindness so they may drink from the cup of oneness.
But never abandon the weak ones and do not lose hope. Explain to each one with perfect kindness and do not become discouraged. Eventually they will become aware and cognizant of the truth.

order.why: Learn responsiveness from the skilled physician.
shortened: As to presenting the teachings by word, the teacher must be as a skillful physician to the patient. Adapt the treatment to the spiritual needs of the patient and do not prescribe for those who refuse treatment."

order.why: Respond to varied needs with varied care.
shortened: Be thou compassionate to every sorrowful one, a dispeller of afflictions to every grieving one, a refuge to every fearful one, heavenly sustenance to every destitute one, refreshing water to every thirsty one, a healing medicine to every sick one, a soothing balm to every wounded one, a consolation to every dejected heart, a blessing to every wretched soul, a treasure to every seeker, and a succour to every lost one---so that thou mayest become a banner of guidance and the essence of piety amidst the maidservants of thy Lord, the Most High.

order.why: Let renewal shape awakening.
Bring glad tidings to the desolate.
shortened: Guide thou the desolate ones to the treasury of the spirit and inform the dwellers in the dust of the tidings of the heavenly realm.
This is the disposition of the friends of God, such are the attributes of the lovers of the Abha Beauty.

order.why: Connect education with life’s fountain.
shortened: It is hoped that you will educate souls under the shade of the Divine Word and lead them to the fountain of everlasting life.

order.why: Cultivate qualities that illumine the horizon.
shortened: Train all people in the attributes of the Ancient Beauty (may my spirit be sacrificed for the dust of the footsteps of His loved ones) and illuminate the horizons with the lights of sanctification.

order.why: Let education advance humanity.
Retain the hope for Bahá’í education’s effects.
shortened: I hope that through this system of Baha'i education you may become the light-reflecting lamps of the Assemblage of mankind.

order.why: Educate children toward service.
shortened: My highest wish and desire is that ye who are my children may be educated according to the teachings of Baha'u'llah and may receive a Baha'i training; that ye may each become a lighted candle in the world of humanity, may be devoted to the service of all mankind, may give up your rest and comfort, so that ye may become the cause of the tranquillity of the world of creation.

order.why: Link raising children with merciful teaching.
shortened: 'Abdu'l-Baha, with utmost humility, supplication and yearning, implores the Abha Kingdom and begs confirmation and success for you, that through the aid and favor of the Desired One you may succeed in raising spiritual children and illumined descendants, each of whom may become a luminous lamp in the sanctuary of divine unity and a merciful teacher in the school of divine love.

order.why: Let nurture precede radiance.
Preserve a pupil’s hoped-for influence.
Bring ideals into college life.
shortened: In the College of Beirut you must become the shining candles of moral precepts and spiritual ideals and be the means of the illumination of others.

order.why: Include music in a life of devotion.
Ask what fruit can now appear.
Let long nurture become present fruitfulness.
shortened: Therefore it is hoped that your honor will strive more than all others in spreading the divine traces and manifesting the mysteries, for that near one of the Divine Threshold has, from early youth, grown and developed under the shade of the favors of the All-Glorious like a fresh sapling under the outpourings of the cloud of divine mercy, and has become a fruitful tree. Now is the time for the appearance of fruit.

order.why: Gather growth through tree and pearl.
shortened: And through the aid and protection of the Blessed Beauty, may you become, under the shade of the Divine Word, fruitful saplings and trees bearing spiritual fruits, may you be the signs of guidance and the standards of the Abha Kingdom, may you be pearls in the shell of grace and dawning-places of the lights of guidance.

order.why: Connect fresh growth with guidance.
shortened: May you become illumined, each as candles through the Light of Guidance, and like unto an ocean -- by the winds of love of God shall you surge. May you become green and fresh and verdant by the breezes of the favor of God. May you yield the fruits of the Kingdom, being the cause of guidance to the people of the earth.

order.why: Imagine a small beginning fruitful in India.
shortened: I hope that this drop will become an ocean, and this atom will become a mighty mountain, that this sapling will grow and develop through the outpourings of the cloud of grace until it becomes a fruitful tree, and that this lamp will become a brilliant torch and bestow light upon India.

order.why: Name existence’s fruit through guidance.
Join kindness with lamp and orchard.
Become mercy for humanity.
shortened: Thus mayest thou be a mercy to the people of the world and a source of bounty to the world of humanity.

order.why: Give freely what was freely received.
Keep the blessing upon giving.
Explore happiness and service nourishing one another.
Make healing visible in a friendship.
shortened: Now my hope is that you too will follow the path of your namesake and become the cause of fellowship, love and healing among the friends, so that you may shine like a candle and gleam like a star.

order.why: Begin with loving relatives.
Let example speak within family.
shortened: Thus thou mayest set a good example in that region; that He may lift up the veil from before the eyes of thy mother and father, so that they may witness the lights of the Kingdom of God, which have encompassed all regions.

order.why: Extend guidance beyond the family.
Read the example of two Zoroastrian women.
Remember a family through wisdom.
Follow a noble father’s path.
Join gratitude to a teacher with fruitful conduct.
Gather friends through refined character.
shortened: In those regions you must be a gatherer of the friends of God and a means for enkindling hearts, purifying souls, and sanctifying human realities from imperfect traits, so that the loved ones of the All-Merciful may shine forth in the assemblage of the world like lamps of guidance and lights of piety.

order.why: Give renewed life a fresh garden.
Calls for responding actively to the light of guidance.
Let an encounter refresh the withered.
Read the specific counsel about Cairo.
Carry pilgrimage’s fruits into daily encounters.
Accept companionship in service.
shortened: I am you partner and you must be my partner in the same way. In the serve of the Holy Threshold, you must share with me and keep me company. Now that you are leaving, there must come from you good news. News which will give me happiness. This is my utmost hope; that each one of you may become a bright candle in the Kingdom of Baha'u'llah."

order.why: Consider one person’s services filling a city.
Dispel ignorance through service.
Give life in the light of oneness.
Connect shared effort with international peace.
Name unity as a source of radiance.
shortened: Through unity the horizons shall become illumined and radiant. We beseech God to aid them with hosts of angels and with the forces of wisdom and utterance.

order.why: Gather peace, oneness and fruitfulness.
Explore the lamp’s attraction for seekers.
Compare it with burning tree and palm.
Keep Joseph’s image in its account of attraction.
Let the star lead a wandering caravan.
Retain the poetic comparison with Jamshíd.
Read hoopoe, Sheba and Solomon together.
shortened: O my two dear friends! His Holiness Sinai has opened his tongue in praise of you, and the honorable Financial Officer has struck the strings of praise and commendation with a sweet melody, for those spiritual friends, like the hoopoe bird of love, guide souls to the divine Sheba, that they may reach the Balqis of divine guidance in the assembly of the Garden of Eden and enter beneath the shade of the true Solomon.

order.why: Return from revelation with light to offer.
Let joy stir others to movement.
Ask what follows from being a ray.
shortened: O flame of the love of God!

The ray must shed light and the sun must rise; the full moon must shine and the star must gleam. Since thou art a ray, beseech thou the Lord to enable thee to give illumination and enlightenment, to brighten the horizons and to consume the world with the fire of the love of God.

order.why: Give warmth and light to hearts.
shortened: Kindle such a fire that it may bestow the warmth of the love of God upon hearts, and light such a lamp that it may illumine the dark world.

order.why: Hear the urgency to illumine the world.
Keep the stated desire for each friend.
Extend responsibility to each person.
shortened: In this glorious day each one must become a night-illumining lamp and enlighten the world.

order.why: Retain the concise call to burn brightly.
Pause over star and candle.
shortened: Shine like a star and glow like a candle.

order.why: Let night reveal the need for light.
Become guides amid creation.
Connect guidance with utterance.
Let remembrance shine among servants.
shortened: Be thou a lamp of the remembrance of thy Lord amongst His servants, that through thee may be illumined the faces of those whom the veils have not withheld from the remembrance of their Lord, the Munificent, the All-Bestowing.

order.why: Keep counsel against corruption in love’s land.
Retain the proclamation accompanying counsel.
shortened: Counsel the people and remind them of this Mighty News. Say: O people! The clouds have been rent asunder and the Lord of Lords hath come.

order.why: Include wisdom’s call for concealment.
Give the aspiration a home in Stuttgart.
shortened: I hope that in Stuttgart the banners of the verses may be raised high and the fire of the love of God may blaze so intensely that it will move the surrounding regions. May those blessed souls each become a brilliant lamp and bestow the light of guidance to all around.

order.why: Keep the prayer for Germany.
Follow the hoped-for torch in London.
shortened: I cherish the hope that, through the blessings and confirmations of God, thou mayest day by day become more illumined and draw nearer to Him, that the confirmations of the Holy Spirit may reach thee, that thy words may touch the hearts and become the cause of the guidance of the souls, and that, through the protection and help vouchsafed by Baha'u'llah, thou mayest raise aloft in London a blazing torch that may endure eternally and cause that land to become illumined.

order.why: Join local gathering with care for the lost.
shortened: From the day that I left America I have ever supplicated God on thy behalf, begging for thee infinite protection and assurance, so that in that city thou mayest be a centre for the Baha'is, for the assemblage of the spiritually minded and for the guidance of a vast multitude; that to the thirsty thou mayest be a fountain of life, and to those who are lost a path to salvation; that to those who are withered thou mayest be a source of joy and gladness, and to the lifeless impart eternal life.

order.why: Let growth benefit a land’s inhabitants.
Keep the call across the black-white divide.
shortened: As much as you can, rely upon God and submit to the divine will, so that you may shine like a candle in the human world and gleam like a star from the horizon of truth and become the cause of guidance for both groups - black and white.

order.why: Pass illumination between East and West.
shortened: Bestow upon them the everlasting life and bless them with the new teachings. Make every one a lighted torch and a warbling nightingale--the king of the rose in the garden. Reveal to them Thine attractive beauty; make each a growing tree on the shore of Thy guidance, bearing the fruit of Thy grace. Thus may the East illumine the West and the West become the East of the Supreme Heaven.

order.why: Extend service across a continent.
shortened: O thou maid-servant of God! Surely, if some holy souls appear and arise to befittingly carry out the commandments and precepts of God, and be engaged in His service, they will verily become centres of light; an illuminating ray will extend from their hearts to all regions and the continent will become radiant.

order.why: Carry knowledge toward distant lands.
Offer light in every visited city.
shortened: May each one of you shine upon each city through which you pass as a radiant star!

order.why: Keep righteousness wherever one dwells.
shortened: In whatever land thou dwellest, may thou be a sign of guidance and a standard of righteousness.

order.why: Retain the response to national labels.
Preserve cloud, sun and source omission.
Let different directions open onto guidance.
shortened: In one direction you will see the lights of the radiance of guidance; in the other direction the Sun of Reality will shine.

order.why: Look toward a country’s future.
Keep the expectation addressed to its friends.
shortened: Therefore we are expecting that every one of those friends may in that country become like a brilliant and luminous candle, and so the Light of Guidance may emanate upon the hearts.

order.why: Bring warmth back to a familiar abode.
shortened: Now that thou hast returned to thy familiar abode, thou must become there a ray of divine bounty and the heat of the Sun of the munificence of the All-Merciful Lord.

order.why: Let a city’s gatherings share the fire.
shortened: Through the grace and gifts of the Ancient Beauty, we hope that in these days you will be so enkindled by the divine fire that you will set the world ablaze, and that your heat will course through the veins and arteries of that region such that you will become the very soul of that clime, the lamp of that city, a brilliant moon in the horizon of the world, and a rising star in the dawning-place of the hopes of the friends, becoming in every gathering a sign of guidance and the standard of the Abha Kingdom.

order.why: Seek progress that lights a region.
Keep the particular journey’s demand for effort.
shortened: However, if His Holiness Abu'l-Fadl's journey is decided upon, you must manifest the meaning of "Enter like men and cast the ball in the field," until you forget everything and become a luminous essence and a gem of the mine of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Retain reassurance to Persian students.
Preserve the condition for national illumination.
shortened: Now everything depends upon the effort of the friends. If with the utmost purity, sanctification and great severance inspire one breath in this terrestrial globe in the diffusion of the Fragrances of God, every one will evolve into a most precious soul. Then and not until then will the Light of Reality illumine that country.

order.why: Receive the hope of a candle among humanity.
shortened: If thou attainest to such bounty, thou shalt become a sign of guidance and a bright candle in the assemblage of humanity.

order.why: Look for enduring light.
shortened: I hope thou mayest become, through the Favour and Bounty of the Blessed Perfection, the means of guiding others, and in the community of the world light a candle whose effulgence shall be everlasting.

order.why: Let assurance sustain guidance.
shortened: I pray for thee that thou mayest ever grow in faith and assurance, shine like unto a torch in the assemblies and bestow upon them the light of guidance.

order.why: Keep the friends’ description as stars.
shortened: O thou who gazest toward God! Today those souls are mentioned and known in the Most Glorious Kingdom and Supreme Heaven who are the dawning-places of the verses of unity and the rising-points of the lights of detachment. They are the stars of the horizon of meanings and the candles of the gathering of the All-Merciful. They close their eyes to the world and all who dwell therein, and strive for the illumination of hearts.

order.why: Let others notice happiness.
shortened: I will pray for you that you may become the cause of upraising the lights of God. May everyone point to you and ask, "Why are these people so happy?"

order.why: Read the call within gatherings of friends.
shortened: In the gathering of friends they must be radiant candles, and in the assemblies of sanctification and the chamber of divine unity, they must be burning torches.

order.why: Make steadfastness visible through women’s service.
shortened: Today the handmaidens of God must be diffusers of the light of guidance and must radiate the brilliance of steadfastness, that they may prove worthy to be maidservants at the Threshold of His Oneness.

order.why: Keep lament beside the wish to gladden hearts.
shortened: I wish for them this illumination. I desire for them this luminosity; so that they may rejoice the hearts and spiritualize the souls - but alas!

order.why: Retain hope for each believer.
Gather joy, sight and hearing.
shortened: Rather, through the endless favors of the All-Merciful Lord, be like a candle illumining every gathering, so that souls might receive glad-tidings, hearts might find joy, eyes might be brightened, and ears might become intimate with the bird of the garden.

order.why: Keep the hope for an illumined realm.
shortened: Strive greatly in good character so that the divine friends may serve all Iranians through their words, deeds and conduct. Like bright candles may they illuminate the realm.

order.why: Move from lamps to suns.
shortened: This being the case, care no more for the world and its desires, but cling to the spiritual world and its gifts, spread the fragrances of God, be submissive to the Word of God, establish a spiritual meeting place where from the incense of sanctity and purity will rise up to God, assemble there with fragrance and spirituality and celebrate the Name of your Lord by day and by night. At that time ye would become illumined lamps, spiritual stars: rather, eternal suns.

order.why: Read the desire for the recipients.
Preserve the portrait of a luminous life.
Let the new spirit appear through illumined friends.
Imagine progress opening hearts.
shortened: Through the favors of Baha'u'llah, may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones, I hope that day by day you will progress in the divine Kingdom and that each one will shine like a bright star from the horizon of the Most Great Guidance, become the cause of guidance for others, make the eyes of souls seeing, make the ears of others hearing, and make hearts aware.

order.why: Give thanks for a torch already lit.
Keep the hope for illumination and success.
shortened: May you become a source of illumination and, through divine bounty, attain success in the celestial Kingdom.

order.why: Let growth flow outward like a sea.
Keep the reported promise of guiding others.
shortened: You are near to God, and day by day you will progress by the knowledge of God toward spiritual joy. Then you will be a source of guidance to others.

order.why: Ask what results a meeting yields.
shortened: We hope that this meeting with us will yield results that shall illumine the hearts and irradiate the souls with the light of supreme guidance.

order.why: Honor Mrs. Goodall and Mrs. Cooper’s example.
Let guidance and piety share heavenly imagery.
shortened: O pure souls! In this Dawning Place of Lights which is the cycle of the Lord, be stars of guidance and planets of piety.

order.why: Illumine through human oneness.
shortened: Thou art honoured in my sight, and I pray to God that thou wilt become as a beacon of guidance in that region, brilliant with the effulgence of the oneness of the human world.

order.why: Receive the stated promise of light.
shortened: When thou attainest to this most exalted station and art confirmed in this supreme bounty, thou shalt become a light of guidance in the dawning-place of creation and a ray of radiance in the horizon of eternity.

order.why: Connect qualities with friends’ hearts.
Receive gifts as a call to mercy.
Keep cited bliss within a personal address.
Give thanks for an enkindled candle.
Gather hope, water and guidance.
Let radiance reach toward the Kingdom.
shortened: O thou candle of the love of God! Be radiant and brilliant in this luminous gathering so that thy rays may ascend and reach the threshold of the Kingdom.

order.why: Keep lifelong striving within a gift.
shortened: In any case, strive at all times with heart and soul to become a lamp of the All-Merciful and a gift of the Lord.

order.why: Preserve the wakefulness-heedlessness contrast.
shortened: All humanity is caught in the slumber of heedlessness while you are awake; all are dead while you have attained eternal life and are raising the call to the divine Kingdom and are the cause of illumination of the human world.

order.why: Name the aspiration to illumine others.
shortened: Nothing is better than that man should become a manifestor of the powers of God and the cause of illuminating the creatures.

order.why: Retain the servant’s welcome.
Give thanks for light already offered.
Let illuminated hearts become lamps.
Join received light with oneness.
shortened: O My dearly loved friend! When the light of the Morn of Divine guidance flasheth and glisteneth from the horizon of truth, the radiant heart of man partaketh of it through the Divine light, the lamp of His bounty beameth forth and sheddeth the light of Oneness, the fire of love is kindled and consumeth the souls of men.

order.why: Seek increasing brightness through growth.
Be a light among friends.
shortened: Be thou an ignited candle of guidance. My hope is that thou mayest become the dawning place of the most great Sign and the manifestation of the most great bestowals.
In the presence of the friends be thou a resplendent light and on the horizon of the all-Merciful be a scintillating star.

order.why: Keep the appeal to those who precede.
shortened: Therefore, you must strive to outstrip all others, that you may be numbered among "those who have preceded, who have preceded - these are they who are brought nigh.

order.why: Join radiance with nurturing all peoples.
Hear affectionate longing for a friend.
Connect nearness with attracting hearts.
shortened: In the sacred hadith He says: "Whoso draweth nigh unto Me a span, I draw nigh unto him a cubit." This drawing nigh is through the guidance of souls and the attraction of hearts.

order.why: Let one’s path become a lesson.
shortened: Be confident in the grace and gift of the Most Great Name, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, and follow such a path in the way of the Glorious Lord that it becomes the cause of guidance for the heedless and a lesson for others.

order.why: Keep the reported personal invitation.
Gather candle, rose and trumpet.
Preserve life’s reported role as evidence.
Appreciate the gift through nearness.
shortened: Therefore you must appreciate the value of this gift so that each one of you may become a lamp lighted with the Fire of the Love of God; day unto day you may be drawn nearer unto God in order that your hearts be inspired with divine Inspirations.

order.why: Close the linked readings with a flame for hearts.
Bring guidance into effort and opening doors.
Consider prayer and unsuccessful effort.
Distinguish a closed door from failure.
Acknowledge the difficulty of separating desire and guidance.
Close with complementary means of discernment and consultation.
shortened: God has endowed human beings with more than one way of receiving guidance in the decisions we have to make, as 'Abdu'l-Baha has explained. There are the Holy Writings, in which are clear directions for the way in which we should live; if an inner voice prompts us to act contrary to the explicit teachings we can be sure that, far from being an inspiration from God, that inner voice is the expression of our own lower nature, and should be disregarded. There is also the gift of intelligence and good judgement--the faculty which distinguishes man form the animal kingdom; God intends us to use this faculty, which can be a powerful instrument for distinguishing between true inspirations and vain imaginings. There is the power of prayer through which we strive to purity our motives, to see the Will of God and to implore His guidance and assistance. There is also the law of consultation, one of the distinguishing features of this great Revelation.

questions: What would it mean to nourish the candle of the heart with wisdom, and what habits might sustain that nourishment?
Which concrete forms of care give substance to illumination, and how could their effects be recognized by the people receiving them?
How do these readings relate inward character, spoken counsel, and visible action when a person hopes to guide someone else?
What can patient education, healing, and kindness teach about responding to different needs without losing hope?
How does Matthew’s image of the lamp and good works illuminate this compilation, and what distinctive purposes remain within each setting?
How might intelligence, effort, prayer, consultation, and attention to circumstances help a person seek guidance when personal desire is difficult to distinguish from inspiration?

references.label: 1 · Matthew 5:13–16 · A lamp and visible good works
references.note: Jesus addresses his hearers through salt, a city, and a lamp that gives light to everyone in the house. The passage connects visible good works with glorifying the heavenly Father. Compare that outward effect with this compilation’s concrete forms of service and care, while attending to the Gospel’s particular setting and purpose.
